title: AI Video Creator Flow + Veo 3.1 + CapCut (Full-Time)
job_title: AI Video Creator Flow + Veo 3.1 + CapCut (Full-Time)
description: What You Will Be Doing You will be producing 10-15 short-form videos per day (25-120 seconds each) for health and wellness pages on Instagram and Facebook . Every morning, you receive a Google Drive folder for each reel — it includes a full production file (every image prompt, video prompt, and dialogue line already written) plus all the reference images you need. Your job is to follow it and turn it into a polished, ready-to-post vertical reel using AI tools and CapCut Pro. This is a production role — 95% of it is execution. You do not write scripts. You do not make creative decisions about content. The only creative judgment you make is ensuring visual continuity from scene to scene — backgrounds, props, wardrobe, and prop placement should flow naturally as the video progresses. If a clip breaks continuity (wrong background, prop disappears, character looks different), you regenerate or adjust. Spotting these is the single most important skill — the difference between a video that gets 10k views and one that gets 100k. The Video Style You Will Produce Full Avatar + B-Roll Cuts. The AI character takes up most of the screen and speaks directly to camera. The video cuts to AI-generated b-roll ---------- nts at key points in the script. Captions and overlays appear throughout. This is the style used for personal, authority-building wellness content. Each production file tells you exactly which scenes need character vs b-roll, and includes the exact image prompts and video prompts for each scene. Tools You Need To Have (required to apply) - Google AI Pro OR Google AI Ultra subscription - CapCut Pro subscription Tools I Provide (after signing) - ElevenLabs — Generate AI voice for select reels using the cloned voice I provide (used on roughly 1 in 4 reels — the rest use the voice built into Veo 3.1) - Veo 3.1 — Turn images into ~8 second video clips with voice - Google Gemini Ultra account — Flow image generation + higher rate limits - Nano Banana Pro — High-quality reference images - Google Drive — Receive production folders, deliver finished videos I will train you on the exact workflow for each tool. Previous experience is a plus but not required — what matters is your ability to learn fast and follow detailed instructions. Basic Editing Skills Needed - Stitching multiple 8-second Veo clips into one coherent video - Spotting visual continuity breaks and fixing them - Adding accurate captions - Cutting dead space, tightening pacing - Minor effects: dynamic zoom, transitions, overlays - Attention to timing and pacing — small details separate viral content from average content Requirements - Active Google AI Pro or Ultra subscription (required) - Active CapCut Pro subscription (required) - Strong CapCut / video editing skills (you must demonstrate this in the recreate assignments below) - Excellent English reading comprehension — production files are detailed and must be followed precisely - Extremely detail-oriented - Reliable, fast internet connection - Available 6-8 hours per day, 5-6 days per week (consistency matters more than fixed hours) - PH timezone or similar - Can receive payments via PayPal - Comfortable learning AI tools (I will train you, but you must be a fast and eager learner) - Good at taking direct feedback and improving fast Pay - Starting: $400/month - Performance raise: $500+/month once you are consistently producing high-quality videos at speed - Big bonuses when content performs well ($50 per 1 million views) - Payment via PayPal, monthly - This is a long-term position. I am building a content network and need someone who can grow with it. The Bigger Picture This is my first VA hire. I am building a content network across multiple wellness brands and I need someone who can grow with me, not just clock hours. The right person here has a clear path to: - $1,000+/month earnings as output and quality scale - A manager role training the next VAs I hire — once you have the workflow locked, you teach it - Real input into how my team operates, what we systemize, what we build next If you want a paycheck only, this is not the role for you. If you want to plant a flag and grow with an operator who is moving fast, this is rare and I will know it when I see it. How to Apply — Two-Stage Recreate Process + Interview Call To apply, you must complete a two-stage recreate process so I can evaluate your skills. This replaces a traditional interview — your work speaks for itself. You will use your own Google AI Pro/Ultra account and your own CapCut Pro throughout. Stage 1 — Recreate 1: Exact Reproduction I will send you: - A reel from my own account - The single reference image I used to make it Your task: Recreate the video as exactly as you can. Match the Nano Banana Pro image generations, the cuts, the editing, and the voice. I want to see your best attempt at reverse-engineering my style. You have 24 hours from receiving the materials to submit via Google Drive: - The finished video (mp4) - A Google Doc with every prompt you wrote — the image prompts AND the Veo prompts. I want to see your thinking, not just the output. - 2-3 sentences on your process: what you noticed about the original, what was hard, what you'd improve. This tests your ability to study a video, reverse-engineer it, and write the prompts that produce something close. This is the most important part of the application. I will review and respond within 24-48 hours. Stage 2 — Recreate 2: Independent Production (only if Recreate 1 is approved) If your Recreate 1 looks strong, I will approve you to move on and send you a production file with all prompts already written. Your task: Produce the complete video from the file. No tutorial, no walkthrough — just execute. You have 24 hours from receiving the materials to submit via Google Drive: - The finished video (mp4) This tests your ability to read a production file and turn it into a polished reel — which is exactly what you will do every day in this role. Stage 3 — The Call If both recreates look strong, we hop on a 15 to 30-minute video call. I will walk you through my full workflow live — exactly how I produce these videos — so you understand what you are signing up for. You will have time to ask me anything and tell me why you would be a great fit. This is how I make the final decision. To Apply, Send a Message With: - Confirmation that you have an active Google AI Pro or Ultra subscription AND an active CapCut Pro subscription - Your CapCut / video editing experience (specific examples, portfolio links, or a brief description of what you have edited before) - Any experience with AI tools (Veo, Google Flow, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Kling, etc.) — even minimal - Your availability (hours per day, days per week, timezone) - One paragraph on why you would be a great fit for this role - Confirming you will deliver Recreate 1 within 24 hours of receiving the materials, and Recreate 2 within 24 hours of approval to move on I will respond within 12 hours of your application with the Recreate 1 materials. This is a production role, not a creative role. If you thrive on following clear systems, delivering consistent quality, and getting better every day, this is for you.

title: Meta Ads Maker
description: Job Title: Meta Ads Maker  (Hourly / Part-Time) About the Brand GOD MADE MAN® is a premium anti-aging skincare brand built specifically for Black men. We sell through our Shopify store at godmademan.store and run paid ads on Meta (Facebook and Instagram). We are a small, new brand with a clear identity and creative strategy. We can provide very specific, detailed creative direction for all our ad projects. We know exactly what we want — we need a skilled VA to actually put it all together. What This Role Is This is a flexible hourly, part-time remote position with flexible hours. All ad strategy, copy, visual direction, prompts, and production briefs you need will be provided. Your job is to take that direction and execute it to a high standard, mostly using AI tools and video/image editing software and other typical resources. This is a creative execution role — not a creative strategy role. Think of yourself as a skilled production assistant working from a highly detailed director's brief. However, we will appreciate your advice and input throughout the process. Hours will be consistent week to week with room to grow as the brand scales. Expected Hours Starts at a minimum of 6-8 hours per week. Hours are flexible — you can work on your own schedule as long as deliverables are completed within agreed turnaround times. As output quality is confirmed and the brand grows, we will request more hours. What You Will Do Execute video ad productions: including avatar generation, lip-syncing, and B-roll assembly (using resources like HeyGen and Higgsfield AI–and/or your preferred tools). Build and edit finished video ads: assembling talking head, UGC and various other types of footage, B-roll product shots, audio, and captions (using resources like CapCut or DaVinci Resolve–and/or your preferred tools) Generate static image ads from provided reference images and copy, using resources like AdCreative.ai and Canva–and/or your preferred tools). Generate product beauty shots and CGI-style visuals (using resources like Higgsfield Marketing Studio–and/or your preferred tools) Produce voice conversions from provided reference audio files (using resources like ElevenLabs and Resemble AI–and/or your preferred tools). Upload and manage ad creatives in Meta Ads Manager — setting up campaigns, ad sets, and running A/B tests per provided instructions Organize and maintain a clean library of all creative assets — video files, image files, audio files, and prompt documents. Communicate clearly and proactively — flagging issues, confirming completion, and asking questions before starting work rather than after. Tools* You Must Know — Required (*Note: We provide subscriptions, if needed.) You must have demonstrable hands-on experience with all of these (or a VERY similar alternative instead): HeyGen — avatar generation and lip-sync CapCut or DaVinci Resolve — video assembly and editing Canva — ad layout and design Meta Ads Manager — campaign setup and creatives management AdCreative.ai — static image ad generation Tools You Should Know (or Be Able to Learn Quickly): Higgsfield AI — Marketing Studio, Lipsync Studio, Soul 2.0, Cinema Studio ElevenLabs — voice cloning and text-to-speech Resemble AI — speech-to-speech voice conversion CloudConvert and mp3cut.net — file conversion and audio editing utilities Who You Are Detail-oriented — you read briefs carefully and follow direction precisely before applying your own judgment Proactive communicator — you ask clarifying questions upfront, not after delivering work that missed the mark High standard for quality — you review your own output critically before submitting it Comfortable with AI tools — you stay current with new features and can troubleshoot when a generation doesn't come out right. Honest about your capabilities — if you don't know a tool, you say so rather than overpromising Reliable — you meet deadlines, track your hours accurately, and communicate immediately if you have a problem, concern, complaint, or any “bad news” we should know about. How Hours and Payment Work You log your hours honestly using a time tracker — Time Doctor, Toggl, or Hubstaff are all acceptable You submit a hours log at the end of each week with a brief summary of tasks completed Payment is made weekly via PayPal, Wise, or GCash — whichever works best for you Minimum commitment 6 hours per week. What a Typical Week Looks Like You will receive detailed written briefs for each ad — including the exact script, Higgsfield or HeyGen prompt, scene breakdown, B-roll timing, audio file, and reference images. Your job is to execute each brief completely and deliver a finished ad ready for Meta upload. You will also receive static ad briefs with reference images, copy, and product photos for AdCreative.ai and Canva execution. A typical week may involve 2–4 video ad productions and/or 2-4 static image ad variants. Hourly Rate $6–10/hour depending on skill level and portfolio quality. Rate reviewed upward after 30 days if output quality and reliability are confirmed. This is an ongoing engagement — not a one-time project. Consistent hours and a long-term working relationship are the goal. Portfolio (REQUIRED) Please include examples of Meta ad creative work you have produced — video and static image. Preference given to candidates with ecommerce, skincare, beauty, or men's grooming brand experience. Work produced using AI tools is preferred over traditional production work — we want to see that you know how to get quality output from the currently-available AI tools. How to Apply Please send the following: A brief introduction — who you are, your background, and why this role fits your skills. (Important: Put the words “I read your job description” at the start of your introduction.) Portfolio*: Links to or samples of at least 4 Meta video ads and 4 image ads that you have produced. A list of the AI tools that you have solid, hands-on experience (please include ONLY tools you have actually used–not tools you only know about) Your time zone and the hours of the day that you typically work. Your hourly rate expectation if different from the range listed above. *Applications without a portfolio of samples cannot be considered. One Last Thing This brand has a very specific visual identity — premium, matte black and copper gold, built for Black men, authentic and non-generic. We are serious about quality. If your portfolio shows work that is polished, on-brand, and clearly executed with care — we really want to hear from you. If your work looks like AI defaults with no creative direction applied — this is not the right fit. Our Promise: Providers LOVE working with us. We are ALWAYS kind and fair. We treat the people we work with very well. godmademan.store

title: Financial Controller
description: Ikigai Cases is hiring a Controller! Location: Remote / Work From Home Reports to: CEO About the Company Ikigai Cases ( ---------- ) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe. Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail. About the Role We are hiring a Controller to take complete ownership of our financial operations - accounting, reporting, payroll, budgeting, cash flow, tax coordination, and financial systems. This is a critical senior role, and we’re looking for someone whose professional identity is built around three things: the integrity of the numbers, running the finance function end-to-end, and providing strategic financial insight to the CEO. The ideal candidate has served as a Controller (or equivalent) for an e-commerce or DTC brand in the $10–30M revenue range. You understand the financial rhythms of e-commerce: Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow swings, sales tax across multiple states, and the speed at which decisions need to be made. If you’ve done this before at a similar-sized company, you already know what we need. At $11.5M in revenue and targeting $30M by 2028, our financial complexity is outpacing our financial infrastructure. We need someone who builds systems, not just operates inside them. You’ll report directly to the CEO and work hand-in-hand with our external financial advisor. No layers of management between you and the decisions your work supports. Core Responsibilities Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Close books by the 10th of every month. Produce reviewed P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements in Finaloop. Resolve misclassifications proactively. Maintain a clean chart of accounts. No CEO intervention required. Budgeting & Financial Planning: Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets. Own budget vs. actuals: produce variance reports monthly alongside the P&L close with plain-language explanations. Update balance sheet items and expenses weekly inside the company’s financial models. Cash Flow Management & Forecasting: Maintain the 13-week cash flow forecast weekly and proactively. Flag upcoming cash movements, exposure, and risks before they become surprises. This is one of the most critical tools the CEO uses for capital allocation. Payroll Operations (Zero-Error Standard): Own bi-weekly payroll across ADP (US) and Deel (Philippines). Submit the morning of payroll day, every cycle. PTO, overtime, and deductions captured before submission. You catch discrepancies before they reach the CEO. Tax Coordination & Compliance: Own the relationship with Numeral on multi-state sales tax filings. Maintain the estimated tax payment tracker. Coordinate with our external CPA on annual filings. Flag tax exposure and timing proactively. Vendor Payments, Disbursements & Financial Systems: Execute and double-check all vendor payments (Venmo, PayPal, wire). Track owner distributions and related-party transactions. Manage Finaloop, Shopify revenue reconciliation, and Google Sheets financial modeling. Manage financial admin including insurance, vendor accounts, and benefits. CEO Reporting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Weekly: 13WCF update, flagged variances, upcoming cash movements. Monthly: clean financial statements with brief narrative. As needed: ad hoc financial analysis without requiring a detailed spec. Why You Should Take This Role -You’ll work at a brand obsessed with its customers, with a loyal following. Read the reviews: ---------- /pages/reviews -A company that’s scaled rapidly in 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth. -You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain. -The company was founded to solve a personal problem - Tavish’s father battled a neurological condition for a decade and the family discovered the issues with plastic pill organizers. -You’ll own the entire financial function for a company on a trajectory from $11.5M to $30M - a career-defining role for the right person. Required Experience & Skills -5+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations -Prior Controller or senior finance role at a company doing $10M+ in annual revenue - you’ve owned the full financial function, not just pieces of it -E-commerce or DTC company experience strongly preferred - Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow, multi-state sales tax -Experience closing books independently, on a monthly cadence, without supervision -Demonstrated accuracy record - you should be able to speak to this specifically -US GAAP familiarity (CPA not required, but you must understand the principles) -Experience preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets -Payroll experience across multiple platforms -Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (SUMIFS, financial modeling, pivot tables) -Strong proficiency with Finaloop, QuickBooks Online, or equivalent cloud accounting platform -Strong written and verbal English; ability to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders Nice-to-Have Experience -Experience working remotely for a US-based company from the Philippines -Exposure to sales tax compliance across multiple US states -Experience using Notion (or similar task management software) -EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity -Prior experience coordinating with external CPAs and tax advisors What We’re Really Looking For -Technical skills get you in the door. These traits determine whether you succeed: -Detail orientation as professional pride - you catch your own errors before they go out, and you change your process so they don’t recur. -Proactive disclosure - you surface problems before being asked, even when it’s uncomfortable. -Ownership without supervision - if it’s due, it’s done. No prompting required. -Direct communication - you push back when something doesn’t look right. -Reliability - when you say you’ll be available, you’re available. When you can’t be, you say so immediately. Compensation Details & Schedule -Compensation: TBD based on candidate experience. Target compensation will be requested during screening. -Work Hours: 50 hours/week, Monday–Friday. Core overlap with US Eastern hours (9AM–5PM EST). -Paid Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year -PTO: 1 week earned for every 6 months worked at the company -Location: Remote / Work From Home To Apply Fill out the application form here: ---------- /jobs/6f92864d-dc4d-41bc ---------- f7bcfcf498e This application includes a number of questions in order to ensure we hire an outstanding candidate for this position, so please be advised in advance that it will take time to complete. description: **Company:** Intent Brands (two brands: Aerotrunk + SurviveX) **Location:** Remote (Philippines preferred) **Type:** Full-time (40 hrs/week) **Compensation:** $2,000 USD/month + 13th month pay **Start:** Immediately --- ## About Us Intent Brands runs two consumer product brands sold on Amazon and our own Shopify store: - **SurviveX** — Premium first aid and emergency preparedness kits. Medical/tactical aesthetic. Clean, confident, authoritative design language. Colors: Red (#E30829), Black (#1A1A1A), Dark Gray (#3D3D3D), White. - **Aerotrunk** — Premium hardside luggage. Modern, aspirational travel lifestyle aesthetic. We're a small, fast-moving team. You won't be "the designer who gets handed mockups to resize." You'll own the entire visual output for both brands — from packaging dielines to Amazon A+ content to social media assets. Your work will be on shelves, in search results, and in customers' hands. --- ## What You'll Actually Do (Weekly) - **Packaging design** — Retail-ready packaging, inserts, labels, and stickers. You'll work directly with dieline templates from our manufacturers and deliver print-ready files (CMYK, bleeds, crop marks, PDF/X-1a or AI). - **Amazon listing images** — Main images, infographics, lifestyle composites, comparison charts, and A+ Content modules. You understand Amazon's image requirements and what converts. - **Brand store pages** — Design and maintain Amazon Brand Store layouts for both brands. - **Shopify assets** — Homepage banners, collection images, email campaign graphics. - **Social media** — Instagram, TikTok, Facebook creative. Static and motion graphics. - **Product photography direction** — You may not shoot photos, but you'll composite, retouch, and art-direct product imagery using renders, stock, and AI-generated elements. - **Brand consistency** — Maintain and evolve brand guidelines for two very different brands simultaneously. --- ## What We're Looking For This is a **senior role**. We're not looking for someone who can use Photoshop — we're looking for someone whose portfolio makes us say "we need to hire this person before someone else does." ### Must-Have Skills - **Packaging design** — You've designed retail packaging that went to print. You know dielines, bleeds, safe zones, overprint, spot colors, and substrate considerations. You've dealt with manufacturer feedback and revised files for production. - **Amazon content** — You've created listing images and A+ content that you can show us. You understand what converts on Amazon (not just what looks pretty). - **Print production** — CMYK, Pantone, PDF/X, press-ready files. You know the difference between RGB mockups and production-ready artwork. - **Adobe Creative Suite mastery** — Illustrator (packaging, vector), Photoshop (compositing, retouching), InDesign (inserts, guides). These are your daily tools, not occasional ones. - **Typography & layout** — You have strong opinions about type hierarchy, spacing, and readability at small scales (packaging, labels, inserts). ### Strong Plus - **Motion graphics** — After Effects or similar for social content, product animations - **3D mockups** — Blender, Dimension, or similar for product visualization - **AI image tools** — Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, or similar for concepting and asset generation - **Figma** — For collaborative design, UI work, or rapid prototyping - **Medical/health product design** — Experience with FDA-regulated labels (Drug Facts panels, mandatory copy) - **Bilingual English** — Your English needs to be strong enough to read briefs, present concepts, and explain design decisions in writing --- ## Screening Questions (Answer All 4) > **Include the phrase "I design for production" somewhere in your application.** This tells us you read the full listing. ### Q1: Packaging Portfolio Piece Show us one packaging project you're most proud of — something that went to physical production. Tell us: - What was the product? - What were the print specs and constraints? - What was your process from concept to final production file? - Show the final printed result (photo of the physical product) alongside your design file if possible. ### Q2: Amazon Listing Challenge Pick one of these two scenarios and walk us through how you'd approach it: **Option A:** Our first aid kit's main image has a 3% click-through rate (below category average of 4.5%). The current image is a straight product shot on white. What would you change and why? What would you A/B test first? **Option B:** We need to create 7 listing images for a new luggage product. Walk us through what each image slot would contain and why, based on what you know converts on Amazon. ### Q3: Two Brands, One Designer SurviveX is medical/tactical (red, black, authoritative). Aerotrunk is travel/lifestyle (modern, aspirational, premium). How do you switch between two very different brand identities without the work starting to look the same? Give us a specific technique or process you use. ### Q4: Tools & Speed What's your full design stack? For each major tool, tell us honestly: daily driver, weekly, or occasional? Also: what's your typical turnaround for a set of 7 Amazon listing images from brief to final delivery? --- ## Paid Test Task Instead of multiple interview rounds, we'll ask our shortlisted candidates to complete a **paid design test** ($75 USD). This lets us evaluate real work, not interview performance. The test will involve: - Redesigning one existing Amazon listing image set (3 images) for SurviveX - Creating one packaging insert concept (front/back) based on a provided dieline and brief You'll receive brand guidelines, existing assets, and a clear brief. We're looking for design quality, brand interpretation, production-readiness, and turnaround speed. --- ## What You Get - **$2,000 USD/month** — paid biweekly, direct deposit - **13th month pay** — standard Philippine labor benefit - **Paid time off** — Philippine holidays + 15 days personal leave - **Creative ownership** — You're not a pixel-pusher. You'll influence brand direction. - **Small team** — Direct access to founders. No layers of middle management. Your ideas get heard. - **Growth** — As the brands grow, you grow. This could become a design lead / creative director path. --- ## How to Apply 1. Answer all 4 screening questions above 2. Include the phrase "I design for production" 3. Link your portfolio (Behance, Dribbble, personal site, or Google Drive — we don't care where, we care what's in it) 4. Include at least 2 examples of **physical product packaging** you designed (not mockups — actual printed products) 5. Tell us your rate expectation and availability **Applications without portfolio links or screening answers will not be reviewed.** We review applications within 48 hours. Shortlisted candidates will receive the paid test task within one week.

description: REMOTE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT (PART-TIME) Hours & Growth Opportunity • Starting at 10-25 hours per week • Starting pay: $4-$8 USD per hour depending on experience, skills, and qualifications • Performance and compensation will be reviewed after the first 60 days • Tea ---------- mbers who demonstrate strong communication, reliability, initiative, attention to detail, and consistent performance will have opportunities for increased responsibility, additional hours, and increased compensation over time • This role has the potential to grow into a full-time position as the business continues to grow • I am looking for a long-term tea ---------- mber and hope to build a working relationship that lasts for years, not months • My goal is to find the right person, invest in them, and create opportunities for growth as the business grows. Hi, my name is Ricky. I run a growing bakery and café in Miami, Florida. The business is growing, the systems are being built, and I’m looking for the right person to help me stay organized, keep information flowing, and help me focus on the highest-value areas of the business. I’m not looking for a typical virtual assistant. I’m looking for someone who enjoys learning, solving problems, staying organized, gathering information, and helping a growing business operate more efficiently. The biggest challenge I have right now isn’t a lack of ideas. It’s a lack of time. Every week I’m managing employees, customers, vendors, inventory, finances, projects, reports, and the day-to-day challenges that come with operating a business. The good news is that many of the systems are already built. I already have the spreadsheets. I already have the trackers. I already have the reporting systems. What I need is someone who can help maintain them, keep them updated, and help gather the information needed to make better decisions. I can teach you the software. I can teach you the systems. I can teach you the process. What I can’t teach is attitude, communication, curiosity, accountability, reliability, and attention to detail. I’m looking for someone who: • Wants to learn and improve • Has a growth mindset • Takes ownership of their work • Asks questions instead of making assumptions • Communicates clearly and consistently • Is dependable and organized • Takes pride in doing things correctly • Enjoys solving problems and finding answers • Wants to become a trusted part of a growing business Examples of responsibilities: • Updating existing Google Sheets and trackers • Pulling information from reports and entering data • Researching vendors, suppliers, products, and services • Comparing pricing and available options • Organizing information into summaries and reports • Helping track projects and follow-up items • Assisting with administrative and research-related tasks The systems are already built. Your job is not to create the systems. Your job is to help maintain them and keep accurate information flowing into them. I don’t expect you to know everything on day one. Training will be provided. What matters most to me is your willingness to learn, communication, attention to detail, and desire to improve over time. If we work well together, there will be opportunities for increased responsibility, additional hours, and increased pay as the business grows. I’m looking for someone who wants to grow with me for years, not someone looking for a short-term gig. ------------------------------------------------------ IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS To help me identify candidates who pay attention to detail, please follow the instructions below: 1. Begin your application with the words “Lucerne Bakery.” 2. Include the word “croqueta” somewhere in your application. 3. Answer the questions below. Questions: 1. Imagine I ask you to research 5 suppliers that sell a specific product for my business. After 30 minutes of research, you can only find 2 suppliers. What would you do next? 2. If I give you instructions for a task and one part is unclear, what would you do? 3. If I ask you for information at 9:00 AM and you realize it will take several hours to complete, how would you communicate with me? 4. Imagine you’ve worked with me for 6 months. What are 3 things you would do to make my life easier as a business owner? 5. Tell me about a time you had to learn a new system, software, or process. How did you approach it? 6. What do you believe is more important: speed, accuracy, communication, or initiative? Rank them from most important to least important and explain why. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: Backend / Operations Manager
description: About us We run a portfolio of fast-growing e-commerce brands across Australia, the UK, US and Canada. Our flagship is a designer lighting brand; the portfolio also spans fashion and home. We're profitable and scaling hard — which means the operational side now needs a dedicated owner instead of being run off the founder's desk. The role in one line Own the day-to-day backend of every store so the operation runs cleanly without the founder in the loop — and turn the money we currently lose to refunds, chargebacks and fulfilment issues into margin we keep. This is not a ticket-closing job. You'll run the operation and improve the systems behind it. Right now roughly 15% of profit leaks to refunds and related issues. Your core mandate is to bring that down meaningfully (target: under 5%) through better process, not just faster firefighting. What you'll own Fulfilment & orders — Make sure every paid order ships within 48 hours, supplier transit times are met, and no order ever sits open. D ---------- on substitutions and out-of-stock situations using our playbook. Refunds — Apply our refund decision matrix (replacement-first where appropriate, store credit before cash, cause-based logic). Approve within your limit; escalate above it. Tag every refund by cause and whether it was preventable. Customer support quality — You don't do the CS yourself; you run quality control over a distributed support team. Monitor first response time, enforce correct template usage, make sure refund/issue tickets get prioritised and resolved fast. Chargebacks — Respond within processor deadlines with proper evidence, and — more importantly — find the root causes and seal the leaks. Keeping our chargeback rate healthy is a priority. Data & optimisation — Own data integrity across our sheets and dashboards. Surface where the leakage concentrates (which supplier, SKU, market) and propose the one or two fixes that move the number each month. This is the part of the job that actually compounds. KPIs you'll be measured on - Refund cost as % of profit (by cause) — trending down - Customer first response time within target - % of issue tickets resolved within 3 exchanges - Chargeback count and % preventable - Orders processed within 48h / supplier SLA hit rate - Data completeness across all tracking You're a fit if you: - Have run operations or backend for a Shopify / dropshipping business before (multi-store and multi-market is a strong plus) Are comfortable with the stack: Shopify, Google Merchant Center, a CS platform (we use Re:amaze), email /Klaviyo, spreadsheets/dashboards, Notion - Think in systems — you instinctively turn a recurring problem into a rule or a process, not a repeated manual fix - Are fully fluent in written English and excellent at concise, no-fluff async communication - Are reliable, self-directed, and able to make decisions inside clear guardrails without checking in constantly - Are numbers-literate — margins, COG, refund rates, chargeback rates mean something to you Nice to have: experience disputing chargebacks, supplier/SLA management and comfort with custom dashboards. How we work: - Fully remote, full-time. - Async-first. You'll run a short daily written standup, a weekly KPI report, and a monthly optimisation note. Real-time messages are reserved for genuine escalations. - You get a clear SOP (decision matrix) from day one and a structured onboarding where you take over tasks in phases over your first 8 weeks. - We measure you on outcomes, not hours online.

title: UX Designer – eCommerce & Conversion Rate Optimization
job_title: UX Designer – eCommerce & Conversion Rate Optimization
description: We are looking for a UX Designer who truly understands how users behave — and how great design directly drives revenue. This role is NOT about making things look pretty. It's about making things WORK. --- WHO WE ARE We are a performance-driven eCommerce team. Every design decision we make is measured by one question: Does it convert? We believe in data-backed design, clean user flows, and removing every possible barrier between a visitor and a purchase. UX at our company is a growth tool — not a decoration department. --- WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design and optimize UX flows for eCommerce stores (product pages, PDPs, checkout, cart, landing pages) - Identify conversion bottlenecks and propose testable, hypothesis-driven solutions - Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups in Figma - Conduct UX audits on existing stores and present actionable improvements - Collaborate closely with our team to implement and A/B test design changes - Stay current with eCommerce UX best practices, CRO frameworks, and buyer psychology --- OUR UX PRINCIPLES (Read carefully — this defines how we work) 1. Function over aesthetics. A beautiful design that doesn't convert is a failed design. Every element must serve a purpose. 2. Less friction, more revenue. We remove every unnecessary click, scroll, and decision from the user's path to purchase. 3. Design for the user, not for yourself. We don't care if something looks clever. We care if it works for real customers. 4. Data is your compass. Gut feeling is a starting point — not a conclusion. We test, measure, and iterate. 5. Clarity beats creativity. If a user has to think twice, we've already lost them. 6. Mobile-first, always. The majority of eCommerce traffic is mobile. If it doesn't work perfectly on mobile, it doesn't ship. 7. Speed matters. Every second of load time costs conversions. Design must consider performance. --- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Strong experience in UX design for eCommerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, or similar platforms) - Solid understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) principles and best practices - Proficiency in Figma — you must be able to design and prototype natively in Figma - Ability to think in user journeys, funnels, and behavioral patterns - Knowledge of A/B testing concepts (Hotjar, Google Optimize, VWO, or similar tools is a plus) - Strong eye for UX copy — microcopy, CTAs, and headlines that convert - Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and meet deadlines --- HOW TO APPLY — IMPORTANT: Applications without a video will NOT be considered. To apply, you must submit a short video (2–5 minutes) in which you: 1. Walk us through at least one Figma UX design you created for an eCommerce context (product page, checkout, landing page, etc.) 2. Explain WHY you made specific design decisions — focus on conversion and user behavior, not aesthetics 3. If you don't have existing eCommerce projects: Pick any real online store, identify a UX/CRO problem on it, and show us how you would redesign or improve it in Figma. We are more interested in how you THINK than what you've already done. Your video should demonstrate: clear thinking, knowledge of eCommerce UX, and a conversion-first mindset. No video = no review. This is non-negotiable. --- We look forward to meeting designers who design with purpose.

title: Senior US Tax Preparer (UltraTax) - Full-Time
description: ABOUT WHYTE CPA P.C. We're a virtual CPA firm in Gilbert, Arizona serving about 60 monthly clients. Our niche is S-corporation owners and real estate investors. Small firm, lean operation, high standards on the work that goes out the door. The owner does all final review and signs every return. He's not trying to hand that off right now — he's trying to stop spending it on cleanup. Right now too much review time goes to fixing prep that should have come in clean. This role exists to fix that. We need a senior preparer whose work product is clean, complete, and well-reasoned enough that the owner's review is fast confirmation, not rework. If you're the kind of preparer who hands up tidy workpapers, flags your own open questions before anyone asks, and never guesses when you could check — read on. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO This is a year-round, full-time, prep-first role. COMPLEX RETURN PREPARATION. Federal and state returns: heavy on 1040s with K-1s, 1120Ss, partnerships, and 1041s. Most returns include K-1s (most prepared by us), Schedule E with rentals, brokerage statements, and frequently a Schedule C or Schedule E pg 1. These are not generic 1040s. You prepare the returns that require senior-level judgment — S-corp basis, Section 199A, depreciation, multistate — from source documents through clean, review-ready work product. QUARTERLY TAX PLANNING PREP. Using UltraTax's tax planner and annualized financials, you build the projection, identify planning opportunities, and flag unreasonable assumptions for the owner's review. IRS AND STATE NOTICE WORK (LATER). Low volume, a few a month. You won't own this on day one — but as you settle in, routine notices (math errors, balance due, missing forms) become work you draft and handle, with the owner reviewing and signing. WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT INCLUDE: bookkeeping (a teammate owns that), and final review/sign-off (the owner does that for now). A NOTE ON GROWTH. This is a prep-first role and we're hiring you to be excellent at prep. If you're ambitious and want to grow toward review work over time, there's genuinely room for that here. If you'd rather be the strongest preparer on the team and settle in for the long haul, that's just as welcome. No pressure either direction — tell us honestly where you sit. WHO YOU ARE You have 5+ years of US tax experience, with the bulk of it in hands-on preparation of complex returns — not bookkeeping, not entry-level data entry. Be ready to talk concretely about the returns you've prepared. You know S-corp work concretely: basis tracking, Section 199A computation, reasonable comp analysis, distributions vs. wages. Partnership and 1041 experience is a strong plus. You have hands-on experience with UltraTax CS, CCH Axcess, Lacerte, or ProConnect. You write in clear, professional English (C1 or higher). Your workpapers and planning memos need to be readable by a reviewer in one pass, and any client-facing notes need to land cleanly. You are detail-oriented and self-policing. When you don't know something, you say so and look it up rather than guessing. You flag your own uncertainty before someone has to ask. Your workpapers are organized enough that someone else can follow your reasoning without a phone call. You are comfortable with AI-augmented workflows. Our process uses Claude and TaxGPT alongside human judgment. Strong candidates are either already using AI tools in their work or genuinely curious to learn — we'll train you on ours. Candidates who view AI as a gimmick are not a fit. You are self-directed in a remote-first environment. The owner travels for portions of the year and time zone overlap will shift accordingly. We need someone who runs their own queue with minimal oversight. Real estate experience (rentals, short-term rentals, cost segregation, 1031 exchanges) is helpful but not required. We can teach the niche; we can't teach prep judgment. SOFTWARE STACK Required: UltraTax CS (preferred) or CCH Axcess, TaxDome, QuickBooks Online familiarity Acceptable in place of UltraTax: Lacerte or ProConnect with willingness to learn UltraTax Not acceptable: Drake-only experience Used in workflow: Claude, TaxGPT, IRS Solutions, Excel, Adobe Acrobat Pro If your tax software experience is Drake only, please don't apply. We're not the right fit. COMPENSATION Base salary: $3,000/month USD (paid twice monthly via Wise, on time, every time) 13th month: $3,000 paid in December, prorated for partial first year Internet stipend: $50/month Health allowance: $75/month Total annual comp: ~$40,500 USD Base may increase to $3,400/month for an exceptional candidate after the test process. Hours: Full-time, salary (not hourly, no overtime). This role follows the tax calendar, and the rhythm matters more than the raw hours. Filing season — roughly January 20 through April 15 — is the heavy stretch. Expect 50–55 hours with full Arizona overlap, and that time is focused return work. We pull back on admin, training, and process projects during the crunch so the prep gets done. Outside season, a standard week is around 40 hours, but it's a different mix — return work alongside admin, process improvement, and your own professional development, at a more sustainable pace. Summer is genuinely lighter. When the workload allows, we run reduced hours — often half-day Fridays, and during the slow stretch those shorter days don't require Arizona overlap at all. That's the firm's call based on what's in the queue, not a fixed schedule you can count on week to week. Light weeks don't cost you pay — you're salaried. Two short periods — late summer and early October, for extensions — return to a focused 40 with normal Arizona overlap. We give advance notice so you can plan around them. Time off: - All standard PH public holidays observed and paid. - A bank of 15 paid days/year (vacation + sick), yours to manage. - One long weekend (Friday–Sunday) off during tax season, scheduled with two weeks' notice. - Outside tax season, you manage your own time — take what you need from your bank, communicate, keep your work current. We don't micromanage the calendar. HIRING PROCESS 1. Application — Submit per the instructions below. Generic applications are discarded immediately. 2. First screen — 30-minute video call with the owner. 3. Paid prep test — One real client (sanitized data), $400 USD, ~2–3 hours, due within 7 days. You build the judgment-heavy workpapers in Excel and write a short prep memo — no tax software required. We're testing your prep judgment, not your software speed. 4. Judgment interview — a 45–60 minute call discussing your test, plus 2–3 scenario questions. 5. Reference check — One reference from a recent supervisor or peer. 6. Offer Total process: 2–3 weeks for serious candidates. HOW TO APPLY Send your application with the subject line: "Senior Preparer — [Your Full Name]" Include the following. If your application doesn't follow this structure, we'll assume you didn't read the post. (Strong, clearly-qualified resumes may still get a follow-up — but answering these up front moves you faster.) 1. Experience summary (3–5 sentences): Your years in US tax, how much is hands-on complex preparation, the type of firm you've worked at, and the volume/type of returns you've prepared. 2. Tax software: Which of UltraTax CS, CCH Axcess, Lacerte, ProConnect have you used? For each, name the specific modules (1040, 1120S, 1065, 1041) and roughly how many returns you've prepared in each. 3. DISC scores (if available). If you haven't taken DISC, OnlineJobs.ph has a free 10-minute test — please take it before applying. 4. A complex return you prepared (a short paragraph): Name a specific judgment call — an S-corp basis or Section 199A position, a tricky depreciation or multistate issue — how you worked it, and how you made your work product clean enough to hand to a reviewer. We want one concrete example with real detail, not your whole résumé. 5. AI in your workflow (2–3 sentences): How do you currently use Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools in your tax work? Required qualifications Hands-on QuickBooks Online proficiency, including reconciliation and month-end close. Demonstrated bookkeeping experience for a company with 1,000+ monthly transactions. Strong attention to classification accuracy and an instinct for what "looks wrong." Preferred Experience with multi-entity bookkeeping (JobTracks operates more than one company). Familiarity with QuickBooks import tools (SaasAnt, Transaction Pro, or similar). Engagement terms Monthly retainer, scope sized to transaction volume. How do you treat a loan origination fee on a 5-year loan? How do you treat a leasing commission on a 10-year lease? How do you classify a guaranty fee paid to the GP? Difference between legal fees for tenant eviction vs property purchase? Is interest an operating expense or financing expense? We will reject applicants who: Do not understand NOI Cannot explain journal entries Have never worked with real estate entities Send copy/paste generic responses Position details: Remote Full-time Must overlap with U.S. Eastern Time!!! job_title: TikTok/Reels Content Research VA + Basic CapCut Editor for AI Image/Video App
description: # Job Title: TikTok/Reels Content Research VA + Basic CapCut Editor for AI Image/Video App ## About the Project We are building **Kreo AI**, a new AI image and video generation mobile app. Kreo AI helps users create AI videos, AI photos, photo-to-video effects, AI dance videos, image edits, and viral social media content. We are looking for a creative and organized Virtual Assistant who understands TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, AI content, viral trends, and basic short-form editing. This role will start with a **3-day paid trial**. If the work is strong, this can become a long-term part-time or full-time role. --- ## Main Goal of the Role Your main job is to help us find viral AI photo/video trends and turn them into content ideas, app template ideas, hooks, captions, and simple short-form videos. We are looking for someone who can help us build a content system for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. This is not only an admin role. We need someone creative, curious, and interested in AI apps and viral content. --- ## Responsibilities ### 1. TikTok / Reels / Shorts Trend Research You will research viral content formats related to: * AI video * AI image generation * Photo-to-video * Image-to-video * AI dance videos * AI photo edits * AI portraits * AI animation * Viral filters and effects * ---------- -style AI videos * Creator tools * Short-form video apps You will collect useful links and organize them clearly in Google Sheets or Notion. --- ### 2. Content Idea Generation You will create content ideas for Kreo AI based on viral trends. Example content ideas: * “Turn your selfie into this” * “AI made my photo dance” * “Photo-to-video AI is getting crazy” * “3 AI effects you need to try” * “Normal photo vs AI video result” * “Which effect should we launch next?” * “This AI turned my selfie into a movie scene” * “Would you try this with your photo?” You should be able to study viral videos and turn them into practical ideas for our app. --- ### 3. AI App Template Ideas You will suggest new AI image and video template ideas for Kreo AI. Example template ideas: * AI Dance * Photo to Video * Cinematic Zoom * Stadium Fan Cam * AI Headshot * Anime Portrait * Fashion Walk * Couple Effect * Pet Dance * Glow-Up Reveal * AI Movie Poster * Product Ad Image * Talking Photo * Viral ---------- Effect * Fantasy Portrait --- ### 4. Hooks and Captions You will write short hooks and captions for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Example hooks: * “This AI turned my selfie into a movie scene.” * “Would you try this with your photo?” * “AI video apps are getting scary good.” * “This photo-to-video effect looks unreal.” * “Which version is better: 1 or 2?” * “This is what AI can do with one photo.” Good English is required. --- ### 5. Basic Short-Form Video Editing You should be able to create simple short-form videos using CapCut, Canva, or similar tools. Basic editing includes: * Vertical 9:16 video editing * Adding text overlays * Cutting clips * Adding captions * Using simple transitions * Creating before/after videos * Creating simple thumbnail/cover images * Exporting TikTok/Reels-ready videos * Organizing finished content for posting Advanced editing is not required, but basic CapCut or Canva skill is preferred. --- ### 6. Competitor Research You will track competitor apps and content. Examples: * AI video generator apps * AI photo editor apps * Photo-to-video apps * AI dance apps * Apps creating viral TikTok/Reels content You will observe: * What content they post * Which videos perform well * What hooks they use * What templates/effects they promote * What ideas Kreo AI should test --- ## Trial Task Before long-term hiring, selected candidates will complete a **3-day paid trial task**. The trial task will include: 1. Find 10 viral AI video examples from TikTok/Reels/Shorts 2. Find 10 viral AI photo/image examples 3. Suggest 10 content ideas for Kreo AI 4. Suggest 10 app template ideas 5. Write 10 short hooks/captions 6. Create 1 simple 10–15 second TikTok/Reel sample using CapCut or Canva 7. Submit everything in an organized Google Sheet or document Please only apply if you are comfortable doing this type of work. --- ## Long-Term Role If the paid trial is successful, this can become a long-term role. We may start with: * 4 hours/day, 5 days/week Then increase to: * full-time, 40 hours/week This depends on performance, quality of work, communication, and reliability. --- ## Daily Tasks After Hiring If hired long term, your daily tasks may include: 1. Find viral TikTok/Reels/Shorts references 2. Suggest AI video content ideas 3. Suggest AI image/photo content ideas 4. Write hooks and captions 5. Track competitor content 6. Suggest Kreo AI template ideas 7. Create simple edited video drafts 8. Send a daily summary report --- ## Required Skills * Strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram Reels * Ability to identify viral content formats * Good English writing skills * Basic CapCut or Canva editing skills * Organized and reliable * Able to use Google Sheets or Notion * Good communication * Interest in AI tools and creative apps * Able to follow instructions and submit work on time * Willing to learn and improve --- ## Nice-to-Have Skills * Experience with AI image/video tools * Experience managing social media pages * Experience with YouTube Shorts * Experience writing TikTok hooks * Experience with UGC content research * Experience finding influencers or creators * Experience with app marketing * Experience with competitor research --- ## Who We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is: * Creative * Fast * Organized * Honest * Detail-oriented * Interested in AI content * Familiar with TikTok/Reels trends * Able to think independently * Good at researching viral ideas * Comfortable with basic video editing * Willing to work long term We do not need a high-end professional video editor at the beginning. We need someone who can research trends, understand what is viral, organize ideas, write hooks, and create simple content drafts. --- ## How to Apply Please apply with the following: 1. Your expected monthly salary for 4 hours/day, 5 days/week 2. Your expected monthly salary for full-time work, 40 hours/week 3. Your available working hours and time zone 4. Your experience with TikTok/Reels research 5. Your experience with CapCut, Canva, or video editing 6. Links to any short-form videos you have edited, if available 7. 3 examples of AI video or AI photo trends you think are popular right now 8. Answer this question: “If you had to promote an AI photo-to-video app on TikTok, what type of video would you create first and why?” Applications that do not answer the question may not be considered.

Preserve capital as the primary operational mandate — profit generation is secondary to drawdown control. Avoid over-leveraging, martingale, grid strategies, and revenge trading in all circumstances. Reporting & Communication Submit weekly performance updates including trade summary, equity curve, and forward outlook. Applications without a verifiable trading history will not be considered. Strategy & Methodology Must be able to clearly articulate the trading methodology used (e.g. price action, smart money concepts, swing trading, algorithmic assistance). Strategy must have a demonstrable positive expectancy over the verified period. Pure martingale, grid, or recovery-based strategies are strictly excluded. Risk Discipline Absolute commitment to the agreed daily and overall drawdown thresholds. Demonstrated ability to remain within predefined risk parameters during adverse market conditions. Psychological Maturity Ability to handle losing streaks with composure and return to strategy without deviation. No history of account blow-ups, uncontrolled drawdowns, or significant unexplained losses. COMPENSATION & TERMS Component Base Retainer: $300 per month, paid regardless of performance Profit Share: 10% to Trader|90% to Account Owner paid monthly Capital Scaling: Starting at $500; scaled significantly upon consistent performance Working Arrangement: 100% remote. Important Notice Applications without a verifiable track record or references to past performance will not be considered. title: Founding Systems Integrator — GoHighLevel, AI Automation & No-Code/Low-Code Systems
job_title: Founding Systems Integrator — GoHighLevel, AI Automation & No-Code/Low-Code Systems
description: # PAY Starting monthly compensation in PHP, based on experience, proof of work, expected weekly hours, and fit. We are cost-conscious because we are still early-stage, but we will pay fairly for someone who can actually solve the right problems. This may start part-time or ramp up over time depending on workload, performance, and mutual fit. # ROLE TYPE Remote contractor role. Long-term opportunity for the right person. # COMPANY Atlas Cybertech --- # ABOUT THE COMPANY Atlas Cybertech is a Canadian AI automation and systems company building internal platforms, CRM infrastructure, automation workflows, and operational systems. We are early-stage and moving quickly toward revenue. That means we need to get our baseline systems live fast, without creating a fragile mess that breaks later. Good-enough, working systems are better than perfect systems that never launch. But “good enough” still needs to be clear, testable, and maintainable. We are not looking for AI hype, random tool-stacking, or “automate everything” thinking. We are looking for someone who can help us build practical MVP systems quickly, especially around GoHighLevel, AI-assisted workflows, no-code/low-code tools, automations, integrations, and internal operations. --- # ROLE SUMMARY This is a *GoHighLevel-heavy role.* GoHighLevel is one of the most important platforms in our business, so you must have real hands-on GHL experience. This role is not GHL-only, but strong GHL ability is central. You will help build and improve Atlas Cybertech’s internal systems across: - GoHighLevel - CRM workflows - No-code/low-code tools - Automations - Forms and intake flows - System of Record structures - Internal portals or dashboards - AI-assisted documentation and SOPs - Light AI-assisted workflows - API/webhook-based integrations where needed We are especially interested in someone who is personally excited about AI and actively experiments with AI tools, AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, automation tools, and new ways to use AI to build faster and work smarter. You do not need to be a full-stack software developer or AI engineer. You do need to be technically sharp, AI-curious, systems-minded, and capable of figuring things out. --- # JOB MISSION Your mission is to help get Atlas Cybertech’s internal operating stack online quickly, then improve it over time. The first priority is helping us get our core MVP systems configured, connected, tested, documented, and usable. The goal is to create systems that: - Reduce manual work - Help us move toward revenue faster - Keep data reasonably clean - Avoid silent failures - Make workflows easier to understand - Make automations easier to troubleshoot - Support future client delivery - Can be documented, maintained, and handed off later This role is ideal for someone who naturally asks: - How do we get this live quickly without making a mess? - Where is the bottleneck? - What data should live where? - What happens if this automation fails? - What is the simplest working version? - How can AI help us build, document, or troubleshoot faster? - How can another person maintain this later? --- # WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON You may help with: - Building and improving GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, tags, custom fields, calendars, forms, automations, snapshots, triggers, and integrations. - Setting up and troubleshooting GHL sub-accounts, workflow logic, CRM stages, and client-style account structures. - Helping structure data in systems like SmartSuite, Airtable, or similar tools. - Connecting forms, CRM, automations, dashboards, portals, and documentation workflows. - Building no-code/low-code automations using tools like Make, Zapier, n8n, or similar platforms. - Troubleshooting broken workflows, triggers, integrations, data-sync issues, and automation failures. - Creating AI-assisted SOPs, workflow maps, field maps, process notes, Loom walkthroughs, and system documentation. - Helping build internal systems for hiring, onboarding, lead handling, client intake, follow-up, and operations. - Supporting AI-assisted workflows where AI helps the process but does not become the source of truth. - Using AI-assisted light coding where appropriate for small scripts, API calls, webhook troubleshooting, data transformations, or internal workflow helpers. - Improving system reliability, error visibility, speed of execution, and handoff readiness. You do not need to be a professional writer, but you do need to care about leaving clear notes and using AI tools to make documentation faster and easier. --- # IMPORTANT ARCHITECTURE PRINCIPLE We separate tools by role. - The System of Record is the main source of truth for important business data. - GoHighLevel is the CRM and workflow layer. - Forms are for intake. - Portals and dashboards are for viewing or interacting with data. - Automation tools move data and trigger workflows. - AI tools can assist, but they do not own the process. GoHighLevel is very important, but it is not automatically the System of Record for everything. If this distinction makes sense to you, this role may be a strong fit. --- # REQUIRED EXPERIENCE You should have real experience with: - GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, tags, custom fields, triggers, calendars, forms, and automations. - GHL troubleshooting and workflow behavior. - CRM setup, pipeline logic, and automation logic. - No-code/low-code automation tools such as Make, Zapier, n8n, or similar. - Basic API/webhook concepts. - Data fields, records, statuses, permissions, and workflow stages. - Troubleshooting broken automations or integrations. - Clear documentation, SOPs, workflow maps, or process notes. - Explaining technical decisions in plain English. - Using AI tools to improve speed, research, documentation, troubleshooting, or technical implementation. You should also have strong personal interest in AI. Ideally, you already spend some of your own time testing, researching, or experimenting with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Codex-style tools, AI coding assistants, AI agents, automation agents, or other AI tools. You do not need to be a full-stack software developer or AI engineer. You do need to be technically sharp enough to understand workflows, data movement, integration logic, AI-assisted workflows, prompting, failure points, and system handoff. --- # HIGH-PRIORITY EXPERIENCE These are especially valuable: - GoHighLevel snapshots - GHL SaaS mode - GHL agency/sub-account setup - GHL AI features or AI Employee-style workflows - Client account cloning or snapshot deployment - Twilio or SMS/calling workflows - A2P / SMS approval workflows - AI appointment-setting bots - AI voice/SMS/chat workflows - Advanced AI tools, AI coding tools, agentic tools, or automation agents The more experience you have with GHL and AI-assisted systems, the better. --- # STRONG BONUS EXPERIENCE These are not all required, but they are useful: - SmartSuite - Airtable - Fillout - Softr - Noloco - Bubble / Glide / Loveable - Google Workspace / Google Drive - Microsoft 365 - Meta / Facebook Ads lead flow - Lead forms, UTM tracking, pipeline attribution, or conversion tracking - KPI dashboards or funnel reporting - Lightweight JavaScript, Python, JSON, or API troubleshooting - Experience supporting agencies, consultants, founder-led companies, or service businesses You do not need to be a media buyer, but paid ads platform literacy is a plus because many systems will connect to lead generation workflows. --- # THIS ROLE IS *NOT* FOR YOU IF Please do not apply if: - You are mainly a VA with light tool experience. - You only know basic GHL admin tasks. - You only build funnels and landing pages. - You only know simple Zapier automations. - You describe yourself mainly as a prompt engineer. - You want a CTO, executive, or management title. - You prefer custom code before checking simpler options. - You add new tools before understanding the current system. - You automate unstable workflows without mapping them first. - You do not like documenting your work. - You give vague answers like “I can automate everything.” - You rely on AI-generated answers without real examples. - You are not personally interested in learning and testing new AI tools. This role is not for beginners. --- # WORKING STYLE This role is a good fit if you are: - Strong with GoHighLevel. - Highly interested in AI tools and automation. - Practical and MVP-minded. - Systems-minded. - Strong at troubleshooting. - Fast, but not reckless. - Comfortable figuring things out independently. - Clear in written and spoken English. - Comfortable working directly with a founder. - Willing to use AI to speed up documentation and technical work. - Able to explain tradeoffs clearly. - Willing to challenge weak ideas respectfully. - Focused on building systems that other people can maintain later. We want speed, but not reckless speed. Good-enough, working systems are better than perfect systems that never launch. But “good enough” still needs to be clear, testable, and maintainable. --- # AUTHORITY BOUNDARIES You will be expected to recommend, build, test, troubleshoot, and document systems. However: - You do not choose new core platforms without approval. - You do not turn GHL into the System of Record by default. - You do not add tools without a clear reason. - You do not build custom-code dependencies unless clearly justified and approved. - You do not redesign the core architecture without discussion. The founder makes final architecture and platform decisions. Your role is to recommend, execute, document, and improve. --- # HIRING PROCESS The hiring process is designed to avoid long live interviews. Shortlisted applicants may complete: - A short recorded screening - A more detailed scenario-based assessment - One paid practical task if selected as a finalist - A short 10-15 minute founder call as the final step The paid practical task is only for finalists. We do not ask many candidates to do unpaid project work. --- # HOW TO APPLY At the top of your application, write this exact phrase: *Atlas Systems* Then answer the questions below. Please answer all screening questions directly in your application. Applications that do not answer the questions will not be considered. Generic AI-written answers will be rejected. Use specific examples from systems you have personally built, fixed, documented, improved, or tested. --- # APPLICATION QUESTIONS 1. Evidence of Ability In 3-5 bullet points, describe the strongest evidence of your ability for this role. Focus on difficult systems, GoHighLevel builds, automations, workflow problems, AI-assisted builds, or technical issues you personally solved. 2. Proof of Work Share any relevant proof of work. Examples: - Loom videos - Screenshots - Diagrams - SOPs - Documentation - Portfolio links - Workflow maps - Case studies Do not share confidential client data. 3. Tool and Skill Experience List the main tools or tool categories you have real experience with. For each category, mention the specific tools, what you personally used them for, and your approximate skill level from 1-10. Categories: - GoHighLevel / CRM systems: Workflows, pipelines, snapshots, SaaS mode, sub-accounts, automations, troubleshooting - Automation tools: Make, Zapier, n8n, Pabbly, Relay, or similar - No-code/low-code tools: Airtable, SmartSuite, Fillout, Softr, Noloco, Bubble, Glide, or similar - AI tools / AI coding / agentic tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Codex-style tools, Gemini, DeepSeek, AI agents, AI coding tools, automation agents, or similar - API / webhook / data integration work: Webhooks, JSON, API calls, data transformations, scripts - Paid ads / lead-flow systems: Meta Ads, lead forms, tracking, attribution, conversion events, UTM/source tracking - SMS/calling systems: Twilio, A2P, calling/SMS workflows, notification systems - Business ops tools: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, ClickUp, Notion, Slack, Google Sheets You are not expected to know every tool listed above. These are examples to help you explain your experience clearly. GoHighLevel experience is the most important. Strong AI interest and automation ability are also very important. The more relevant tools and systems you know, the better. 4. Availability and Starting Compensation Please provide the following: - Desired starting monthly compensation in PHP for the first 1-3 months while onboarding, learning our systems, and ramping up. - Number of hours per week this monthly amount assumes. - Maximum hours per week you are available to work consistently. - Target long-term monthly compensation in PHP after the first 1-3 months, assuming strong performance and good fit. - Usual work window in Philippine time, such as morning, afternoon, evening, late night, overnight, or flexible. - Earliest available start date. --- # FINAL NOTE We are cost-conscious because we are still early-stage, but we will pay fairly for someone who can actually solve the right problems. We are looking for the best mix of capability, reliability, speed, judgment, AI interest, GHL ability, and reasonable cost. If you enjoy building systems, solving technical puzzles, experimenting with AI tools, improving workflows, and making operations run better, this role may be a strong fit.

Save working prompts for future reuse. Identify which prompt changes improved or worsened the result. Convert a visual direction into a reusable prompt structure. Test multiple versions without losing the original direction. Experience with JSON-style image prompts is a major plus. The goal is not to copy blindly. The goal is to understand the style system and create something that feels like it belongs in the same visual world. Required Skills: You must have experience with: Canva or Figma Graphic design for social media Strong typography basics Good layout and spacing Visual reference matching Exporting for Instagram, Facebook , web, and ads Following brand guidelines Creating clean, organized folders Naming files properly Taking feedback and improving designs AI Tool Experience Please list any tools you have used, such as: ChatGPT - Image2 Claude Canva AI Other AI image or design tools You do not need to know every tool. Designs that ignore the reference style. Someone who changes the whole direction without being asked. Someone who only knows how to type one sentence into an image generator. Someone who cannot organize source files and prompt versions. Nice-to-Have Skills These are helpful but not required: Photoshop Illustrator Figma Jitter Basic motion graphics Presentation design Ad creative design Experience creating design systems Experience with product mockups Experience creating layered PSD or Figma files Experience working inside JSON prompt systems Tools We Use: Canva Figma Photoshop Google Drive Google Docs Google Sheets ClickUp Claude ChatGPT Example Projects You May Work On A luxury Caribbean villa needs carousel graphics and ad visuals. A tourism campaign needs polished visual concepts. A construction/home brand needs high-end Instagram graphics. A pitch deck needs cleaner visuals and mockups. A static ad needs to be recreated as a more polished layout. A client gives us an inspiration image and asks us to match the design style. What Success Looks Like After 30 Days By the end of the first 30 days: You have completed several test graphics using our workflow. You understand how we organize references, prompts, exports, and source files. You have created reusable Canva or Figma templates. You have helped improve at least one existing JSON/image generation workflow. You can create 3–5 strong visual options from one direction. You can identify and fix common AI-looking issues. You are able to produce graphics with less back-and-forth. Hours and Pay Start project-based or part-time. This can grow into ongoing weekly work if the quality is strong. Please include your desired hourly rate, monthly rate, or project rate in your application. Application Instructions To apply, please send a message with the subject line: VEYA AI GRAPHICS - [Your Name] In your application, include: A short introduction. Your graphic design experience. Your AI image/design tool experience. A link to your portfolio. Examples of AI-assisted graphics you have created, if available. Your experience with Canva, Figma, Photoshop, or Illustrator. Your experience with structured prompts or JSON prompts, if any. Your desired hourly, monthly, or project rate. Your availability in Philippine time. Your computer setup and internet speed. description: # Telemarketer (Singapore Homeowners Outreach) ### Position: Part-Time Telemarketer **Working Hours:** 4 Hours Per Day **Location:** Remote / Work From Home **Industry:** Real Estate ## About The Role We are looking for confident and professional Telemarketers to contact Singapore homeowners and conduct an initial qualification process. Your primary responsibility is not sales. Your role is to identify homeowner interest, gather key information, and filter qualified prospects before passing them to our property consultants for further engagement. This is a performance-driven role suited for individuals who are comfortable speaking with people, handling objections, and maintaining a positive attitude over high call volumes. --- ## Key Responsibilities ### Lead Qualification * Contact homeowners from provided databases. * Introduce the purpose of the call professionally and confidently. * Determine the homeowner's level of interest through structured questioning. * Identify potential intentions such as: * Selling their property * Upgrading to another home * Property investment opportunities * Market valuation enquiries * General property-related concerns ### Information Gathering * Verify homeowner details. * Collect and update relevant information within the CRM. * Accurately record responses and call outcomes. * Categorize leads based on qualification criteria. ### Appointment Generation * Identify qualified homeowners suitable for consultation. * Secure appointments or callback opportunities for the sales team. * Ensure all appointment details are properly documented. ### Database Management * Maintain accurate records of all interactions. * Update CRM notes after every conversation. * Flag high-potential opportunities for immediate follow-up. --- ## Requirements ### Essential * Comfortable speaking English over the phone. * Clear communication and active listening skills. * Positive attitude and resilience when facing rejection. * Basic computer literacy. * Ability to follow scripts while maintaining natural conversation flow. * Reliable internet connection and quiet working environment. ### Preferred * Previous telemarketing, customer service, call centre, insurance, banking, or real estate experience. * Familiarity with CRM systems. * Understanding of Singapore residential property market. --- ## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) * Daily call volume achieved. * Contact rate. * Qualified leads generated. * Appointments secured. * Accuracy of CRM updates. * Attendance and punctuality. --- ## Compensation Structure ### Option 1: Fixed Hourly * Competitive hourly rate. * Performance bonuses for qualified leads and appointments generated. ### Option 2: Hybrid * Basic hourly allowance. * Additional incentive for: * Qualified Leads * Appointments Set * Deals Successfully Closed --- ## Ideal Candidate You are someone who: * Enjoys speaking with people. * Can remain professional despite rejection. * Is goal-oriented and self-motivated. * Understands that your role is to identify opportunities, not hard-sell. * Takes pride in gathering accurate information and creating opportunities for the team. ### Daily Expectation * 4 hours of outbound calling. * Consistent lead follow-up. * Accurate CRM updates. * Delivery of qualified homeowner leads to the sales team. **Objective:** Generate and qualify homeowner interest efficiently, ensuring only relevant and motivated prospects are passed on for further consultation by our property advisors.
