job_title: Social Media Manager & Digital Growth Specialist
description: US Panels — Job Description Social Media Manager & Digital Growth Specialist Type: Full-Time · Remote Experience: 3–5 Years Industry: Commercial Construction / Building Materials Social Media Management   ·   SEO   ·   PPC   ·   Website Optimization   ·   AI Marketing Tools ROLE OVERVIEW US Panels manufactures insulated metal panel (IMP) systems serving cold storage, warehouse, food processing, data center, and industrial construction markets. We are scaling our digital presence and need someone who can take our content and turn it into reach, traffic, and leads. The Social Media Manager & Digital Growth Specialist owns our front-facing digital presence: social media channels, paid campaigns, SEO performance, and the website itself. You will work hand-in-hand with the content creator to publish and distribute assets, and you will use AI tools to accelerate every part of that process — from scheduling and copywriting to ad optimization and SEO analysis. This role is equal parts creative and analytical. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Social Media Management & Publishing • Own day-to-day management of all company social accounts: LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook , and X (Twitter ). • Publish content on a consistent, platform-optimized schedule using a shared content calendar. • Write or adapt captions, hashtags, and post copy for each platform's audience and algorithm. • Monitor all channels for comments, messages, and mentions — respond promptly and professionally. • Engage proactively with followers, construction industry accounts, and relevant conversations to grow organic reach. • Identify and engage with potential prospects and partners through social listening and community participation. Content Distribution & Campaign Execution • Receive content assets from the content creator and distribute them across platforms with platform-specific formatting and copy. • Run boosted post and paid social campaigns on LinkedIn and Meta to amplify high-performing organic content. • Develop and execute targeted social ad campaigns designed to reach architects, GCs, developers, and cold storage facility owners. • Manage campaign budgets, targeting parameters, and creative testing for all paid social activity. SEO Optimization • Own on-page SEO across the company website: meta titles and descriptions, header structure, internal linking, image alt text, and keyword placement. • Conduct ongoing keyword research to identify high-value search opportunities in commercial construction and IMP-related topics. • Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic trends, and technical SEO health using Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Ahrefs. • Coordinate with the content creator to ensure new articles and pages are SEO-optimized before publishing. • Identify and flag technical SEO issues (crawl errors, page speed, mobile usability) and work to resolve them. PPC & Paid Search • Build, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns targeting commercial construction search terms. • Set up and refine ad groups, keyword match types, negative keyword lists, and bidding strategies. • Write ad copy and test variations to improve click-through rates and quality scores. • Monitor spend, CPC, conversion rates, and ROAS; optimize campaigns weekly to improve efficiency. • Coordinate landing page messaging with active PPC campaigns to maximize conversion. Website Management & Landing Page Optimization • Manage and update website content in WordPress or the company CMS — page copy, images, CTAs, and layout. • Build and improve landing pages for campaigns, lead magnets, and product categories. • Run A/B tests on page elements (headlines, CTAs, form placement) to improve conversion rates. • Ensure the website is current, professional, and aligned with active marketing campaigns at all times. • Identify UX issues that create friction for visitors and work with available resources to resolve them. AI Marketing Tools • Use AI tools to accelerate social caption writing, ad copy generation, headline testing, and keyword research. • Apply AI scheduling and optimization tools to improve posting timing and engagement prediction. • Stay current on AI marketing tools and bring new capabilities into the workflow proactively. • Use AI-powered analytics tools to surface insights from social and website performance data faster. Analytics & Reporting • Track and report weekly or monthly on: social follower growth, engagement rates, reach, website traffic, keyword rankings, PPC performance, and leads generated. • Use Google Analytics, Search Console, and platform analytics to build a clear picture of what is driving results. • Provide actionable performance summaries to leadership with clear recommendations, not just numbers. • Monitor competitor digital presence and identify opportunities to outperform them in search and social. REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE Social Media Management • 3–5 years managing professional or B2B social accounts across LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook , and X. • Proven ability to grow followers and engagement on professional audiences — not just consumer brands. • Experience with social scheduling tools: Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout Social, or similar. SEO • Solid working knowledge of on-page SEO: keyword placement, meta optimization, internal linking, and technical SEO basics. • Hands-on experience with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics. • Ability to coordinate SEO strategy with a content team rather than working in isolation. Paid Advertising (PPC & Paid Social) • Experience managing Google Ads campaigns — search, display, or both. • Experience running paid social campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and/or Meta Ads Manager. • Comfortable managing budgets, writing ad copy, and optimizing campaigns based on performance data. title: Experienced Real Estate Caller - Lead Manager

description: We are hiring a Lead Manager to nurture and manage our pipeline of real estate leads, ensuring no opportunities slip through the cracks. As a Lead Manager, you will be the main point of contact for warm leads: following up with prospects, building rapport, and guiding them until they are ready to close or speak with our acquisitions closer. Additionally, you will engage in targeted outbound prospecting, using our high-quality data (e.g. fresh county records for probate and foreclosures) to initiate conversations with potential sellers. This hybrid role is critical – you'll keep our funnel organized and full by both managing incoming leads and proactively hunting new ones. If you are a people-person who is also organized and driven, this could be a perfect fit. Who We Are: The OmniKey Group is founded and led by top-ranking Fortune 500 Sales Managers with a proven track record of developing and employing elite talent. We don't just build businesses — we build careers. As we scale aggressively, we are looking for driven individuals who want to grow alongside a leadership team that knows how to invest in people. Responsibilities: Lead Nurturing: Manage a pipeline of ~50 active leads in our CRM. Promptly follow up with interested home sellers via phone, text, and email . Your goal is to build relationships over time – check in regularly, understand their situation, and keep our company top-of-mind for when they're ready to sell. Initial Lead Qualification: Call new inquiries (from inbound calls or web forms) as soon as they come in. Have a friendly introductory conversation to gather information: Why might they sell? When? What's the property condition? Identify serious motivation versus casual interest. Ensure every new lead is contacted and categorized (hot, warm, long-term, etc.). Set Appointments: When a lead is qualified and shows strong interest/motivation, schedule an appointment or transfer the call to our acquisitions closer. You control the calendar for our acquisition team – scheduling consultations or property visits. Make sure our closer gets all key information before the meeting. Outbound Prospecting: Devote part of your time to reaching out to cold prospects from our premium data lists (such as probate, pre-foreclosure, or other niche lists we've pulled). Use cold calling or personalized texts/emails to introduce our service and see if they have a property they might consider selling. This "deep prospecting" uses the valuable data provided by our Data Manager to generate new leads beyond the ones who come to us. Pipeline Organization: Keep the CRM updated meticulously. Log every call, update lead statuses, and add detailed notes after each contact. Set follow-up reminders for each lead so you always remember to call back when promised. No lead should ever be forgotten or left without a next action. Team Coordination: Work closely with the acquisitions (closing) team. Clearly hand off highly motivated leads with full context (notes about the seller's situation, motivation level, etc.). After our closer makes an offer, circle back with the seller to address any concerns or continue nurturing if they didn't sign immediately. Essentially, you bridge the gap between initial interest and closed deal, keeping communication smooth. Requirements: Excellent Communication: Fluent English speaker who can converse naturally and confidently with U.S. homeowners. You have a friendly phone demeanor, active listening skills, and can build trust over multiple conversations. (Experience talking to older American homeowners is a plus – you can strike the right tone of patience and professionalism.) Sales/Customer Service Experience: 1+ year in a role like sales representative, account manager, customer service, or any position requiring consistent client follow-up. Real estate experience (especially in investing or related to motivated sellers) is highly advantageous – if you've dealt with sellers or real estate leads before, let us know! Follow-Up and Organizational Skills: A proven ability to juggle dozens of leads and keep an organized system. You never let a task or callback slip. Using a CRM or lead management system should be second nature to you. (If you pride yourself on color-coded spreadsheets or meticulous task lists, that's a good sign!)Google Drive Persuasion & Empathy: You know how to connect with people, ask the right questions, and handle objections. You're empathetic to sellers' situations (many may be in tough circumstances like foreclosure, probate, etc.) and also persuasive in highlighting how our service can help them. Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with CRM software, click-to-call phone systems, and general productivity tools (Google Workspace, etc.). Able to learn new apps quickly. Also, must have reliable internet and a headset/quiet workspace for frequent calls. Work Hours: Available to work full-time on US hours (e.g. 9am–6pm PST). Leads must be called quickly during da ---------- hours in the US. Flexibility to occasionally adjust hours for an urgent lead is appreciated. We are seeking someone who can commit long-term (12+ months) and become an integral part of the team. What We Offer: Base Pay + Commission: Competitive base salary plus commission on each deal you help close. Your earning potential grows with every deal. Impactful Work: This role is at the heart of our business – you will directly influence our revenue by turning leads into deals. It's rewarding to see your relationship-building result in a family helped and a successful transaction. We need someone who understands how to use GoHighLevel to turn organic traffic from social media, DMs, content, partnerships, webinars, and landing pages into real leads and sales. ## Main Role Your job will be to help us use GoHighLevel as the backend sales machine for our business. This includes: * Building and managing GHL funnels * Creating landing pages and opt-in pages * Creating forms, surveys, and lead capture systems * Setting up CRM pipelines * Building email and SMS automation workflows * Setting up follow-up sequences for leads * Tracking where each lead is in the sales process * Creating tags, triggers, and smart lists * Helping improve conversion rates * Creating sales pages and payment links * Organizing leads from organic marketing channels * Helping us turn social media attention into leads and customers ## Important: We Need a GHL Expert, Not Just a Task Taker We are looking for someone who knows GoHighLevel better than we do. You should be able to recommend the best way to set things up instead of waiting for us to explain every detail. We want someone who can say: “This is the best way to build the funnel.” “This workflow should be improved.” “This automation can help increase sales.” “This new GHL feature would help the business.” “This pipeline needs to be cleaned up.” “This lead source is converting better than the others.” You must be someone who thinks strategically and understands how CRM, funnels, automation, and sales all work together. ## Responsibilities * Build and maintain GoHighLevel funnels * Create landing pages for different offers * Create lead magnets, opt-in forms, and surveys * Set up CRM pipelines for lead tracking * Build automation workflows using email and SMS * Set up follow-up sequences for cold, warm, and hot leads * Track funnel performance and lead movement * Help organize leads from social media and organic traffic * Create simple reports showing leads, conversions, and sales activity * Test and improve pages, forms, and automations * Stay updated on new GoHighLevel features * Recommend and roll out new GHL tools/features that can help the company grow * Help create a repeatable system that turns organic content into customers ## Required Skills You must have real experience with: * GoHighLevel CRM * GHL funnels and websites * GHL workflows and automations * Email and SMS campaigns * Forms and surveys * Tags, triggers, and smart lists * Pipelines and opportunities * Lead nurturing * Sales follow-up systems * Basic funnel strategy * Basic copywriting for landing pages and follow-up messages * Understanding how organic traffic can become leads and sales ## Preferred Experience Experience with any of the following is a plus: * Business credit, finance, coaching, digital products, or service-based businesses * Organic social media lead generation * Webinar funnels * Course or digital product funnels * Stripe/payment setup inside GHL * Appointment or consultation funnels * Affiliate or referral tracking * AI tools inside GoHighLevel * Reporting and conversion tracking ## What We Are Building We are building a system where organic marketing creates attention, and GoHighLevel captures and converts that attention into leads and sales. The process will look like this: Organic content ? funnel/landing page ? lead form/survey ? automated follow-up ? CRM pipeline ? sales page/payment link ? customer follow-up Your role is to help build, manage, and improve this system. ## Work Style We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is: * Proactive * Strategic * Organized * Experienced with GoHighLevel * Detail-oriented * Good at solving problems * Comfortable making recommendations * Able to work with minimal training * Willing to learn new GHL features * Focused on results, not just completing tasks We do not want someone who only waits for instructions. We want someone who can help us make the system better. ## Starting Pay Starting pay is **$6 USD per hour**. This is the starting rate while we confirm your skill level, reliability, and ability to generate results. Once expert-level ability is shown, the system is running properly, leads are being captured, and sales are being generated, we are open to paying much more. We are looking for someone who can grow with the company long-term. ## Schedule Part-time to start, with the opportunity to grow into more hours based on performance. Please include your availability and preferred working hours in your application. ## How to Apply Please answer the following questions when applying: 1. How long have you been using GoHighLevel? 2. What parts of GHL are you strongest in? 3. Have you built funnels inside GHL before? Please describe one. 4. Have you built email /SMS automation workflows before? Please describe one. 5. Have you worked with organic lead generation before? 6. What GHL feature do you think most businesses underuse? 7. If we had social media traffic but no paid ads, how would you use GHL to turn that traffic into leads and sales? 8. Please send examples, screenshots, Loom videos, or a short explanation of GHL work you have done. 9. What is your desired hourly rate after proving expert-level results? ## Final Note We are looking for a GoHighLevel specialist who can help us build a real sales system. If you are only a general VA with basic admin experience, this may not be the right role. If you are confident with GHL, funnels, CRM, automations, and organic lead conversion, we would love to hear from you.

description: Part-Time IT & Security Engineer (Tier 2/3) Weekend Coverage + Optional Weekday Evenings | Remote, Philippines Sentry is a US-based managed service provider (MSP) and physical security integrator serving small and mid-sized businesses across the New York metro area. On the IT side, we manage our clients' networks, servers, Microsoft 365 environments, endpoints, and phone systems. On the security side, we design, install, and support their video surveillance and access control systems. We do things differently from most MSPs: we don't run a Tier 1 help desk. When a client reaches us, they get a skilled engineer who takes ownership immediately, not a scripted first-tier queue or an automated phone tree. That first-contact competence is a big part of why our clients enjoy working with us, and it's why we only hire technicians at Tier 2 and above. We're hiring part-time to cover our weekends, Saturday and Sunday, and we have additional weekday evening shifts available for the right person. Weekends and evenings are much quieter than our weekday daytime operation, so this isn't a high-pressure call queue. You'll handle the calls, email s, and tickets that do come in, owning each from first contact through resolution, and spend the rest of your time moving project work forward: deployments, configurations, maintenance windows, documentation, and backlog cleanup. Weekends and evenings are also when we can safely take systems offline for upgrades that would disrupt clients during the day, so a meaningful part of this role is planned project execution, not just reactive support. The weekend coverage is what we're most eager to fill. If you're interested, you can also pick up one or more weekday evening shifts on top of it; the full schedule is below. Because you'll often be our main presence outside core business hours, independence and sound judgment matter here. You won't be alone: you'll have escalation paths to senior engineers and the owner, and we take on the hardest problems as a team, but you should be comfortable owning a client environment and knowing when to escalate. The role is fully remote, and you'll be a full member of our team, not an isolated, outsourced contractor. What You'll Do - Handle client requests by phone, email , and ticket during your shifts, and own them from first contact through resolution - Deliver a confident, professional experience on every interaction; clients should feel they're in good hands from the first minute - Execute project work handed off from the weekday team: deployments, migrations, network and system configuration, and backlog items that need uninterrupted time to complete - Run maintenance windows: patching, firmware upgrades, server maintenance, and other changes best done while clients are offline - Administer Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD): user and license provisioning, Exchange Online, mail flow, and email security - Monitor and respond to RMM alerts (Atera) and manage endpoint security tools (Huntress, Bitdefender) - Troubleshoot networks: firewalls (FortiGate), switches and access points (UniFi), VLANs, VPNs, and DNS - Administer Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy - Manage and verify backups (Datto) - Support VoIP systems and IP phones - Configure, support, and troubleshoot video surveillance systems (IP cameras, NVRs, and video management software such as Hikvision, Digital Watchdog, and Speco), including secure remote access and viewing - Administer access control systems (users, credentials, and door schedules) and troubleshoot controllers and readers - Remotely support our field technicians during security-system installs and service calls - Keep clear, accurate documentation for every client environment, including writing up the project work you complete - Work alongside our AI tooling, which we use heavily across daily operations What We're Looking For - 3+ years of hands-on IT support experience, ideally at an MSP - Excellent spoken and written English, with a strong customer-first attitude; you'll be the voice of our company on every call - The confidence to own client interactions and project work independently, along with the judgment to know when to involve the team - Self-direction: with lighter supervision outside business hours, you should be able to pick up a project, see it through, and document it without hand-holding - Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365/Entra, Windows Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals - Hands-on experience with firewalls and managed switches (FortiGate and UniFi a strong plus) - Experience with IP video surveillance and/or access control systems, or the aptitude and willingness to develop this expertise quickly (it's a core part of what we do) - Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection - A quiet, dedicated home workspace Bonus Points - Deep familiarity with AI tools, especially Claude, which we use extensively day to day - Spanish-speaking ability (written and/or spoken) - Hands-on experience with VMS platforms (e.g., DW Spectrum), access control systems, or remote video monitoring services (e.g., Immix) - Certifications (CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+, Microsoft, Fortinet NSE, Ubiquiti, Cisco CCNA) - PowerShell or other scripting Work Setup - 100% remote, based in the Philippines - Part-time, permanent employee position, not contract work - All hours are in US Eastern Time, which maps to an overnight or early-morning shift in the Philippines (about an hour later when the US is on standard time) Weekend coverage, the core of this role (both days): - Saturday, 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 10:00 PM Sat to 10:00 AM Sun PHT) - Sunday, 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 10:00 PM Sun to 10:00 AM Mon PHT) - About 24 hours per week Optional weekday evening shifts, pick any one, two, or all three: - Tuesday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM Wed PHT) - Thursday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM Fri PHT) - Friday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM Sat PHT) - 5 hours per shift What We Offer - Competitive USD pay, scaled to the shifts you take (same hourly-equivalent rate across all of them): - Weekend coverage (Saturday and Sunday): $1,200 to $1,500 per month, based on experience - Each weekday evening shift you add: approximately $250 to $315 per month per shift - For reference, taking all five shifts works out to roughly a full-time load at about $1,950 to $2,450 per month - Paid time off, pro-rated for a part-time schedule - A stable, long-term role with real room to grow, including the potential to expand into more hours - A supportive, AI-forward team that invests in its people How to Apply To apply, send your resume and a short note about your MSP and IT experience, including any hands-on work with security systems and AI tools, and let us know which shifts you're available for: weekend coverage, weekday evenings, or both.

job_title: Lead Generation Operations Lead — Job Posting, ATS & Digital Channels
description: This is not a standard VA role. I am building a serious performance-based operation and I need one exceptional person who already understands job boards and US hiring platforms — and is ready to grow into running the full operation alongside me. If you have hands-on experience posting jobs on Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Lensa, Craigslist, or similar US job boards — and you understand how to get listings live, indexed, and driving real applicant volume — read every word below. ABOUT THE OPERATION I run a US-facing lead generation and recruitment technology business. The core engine is driving job applicants through multiple ATS platforms and job boards into a conversion funnel. Revenue is performance-based — volume and consistency directly determine income, for the business and for you through bonuses. This is not a slow corporate job. Things move fast, methods change, platforms shift. I need someone who thrives in that environment — not someone who needs a fixed manual to follow every day. WHAT YOUR CORE JOB IS Job board posting is your primary function and your specialty. Specifically: — Post jobs daily at volume across Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Lensa, Craigslist, state job boards, and any other US platform you know or discover. — Understand how to get listings properly indexed and visible — not just posted. — Manage multiple posting accounts across platforms cleanly without mixing anything up. — Know which job categories, titles, and descriptions drive the most applicant volume — and apply that knowledge. — Track daily results, report what is working, and suggest improvements without being asked. — Proactively find new job boards, new posting angles, and new traffic sources on your own initiative. WHAT ELSE YOU WILL DO Beyond job posting, this role grows into: — Researching companies and joining software demo calls for ATS platforms like Lever, Greenhouse, iCIMS, and SmartRecruiters — I bring the company, you prepare and represent us professionally. — Managing multiple platform accounts cleanly using tools like incogniton browsing, proxies, and separate credentials where needed. — First-line problem solving — when accounts get restricted or platforms change, you troubleshoot before it reaches me. — Once you understand any method fully, you train new tea ---------- mbers on it — documented, structured, need-to-know basis. — Research into new acquisition channels and outreach methods beyond job boards — social platforms, direct outreach, whatever you identify as having potential. — Daily reporting, documentation, and becoming the operational memory of the business. THE MOST IMPORTANT QUALITY You learn fast and work independently. I explain something once. You figure out the rest. When something breaks you try five approaches before you come to me. This quality matters more than any specific skill you already have. THE KIND OF PERSON WHO THRIVES HERE — You genuinely enjoy repetitive, manual, high-volume work — the grind does not exhaust you. — You are emotionally steady — demo calls involve pressure, new platforms involve constant failure, and you stay calm through both. — You take full ownership. If something is your responsibility and it is not done, you feel it personally. — You are organized and write everything down — processes, results, what worked, what did not. — You are honest. This is a high-trust role with real access and real responsibility. — You want to grow — from executor into someone who runs a team. SKILLS Must have — Hands-on experience posting jobs on US platforms — Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Lensa, Craigslist, or similar. This is non-negotiable as your core function. — Understanding of how job listings get indexed and drive applicant volume — not just how to submit a form. — Experience managing multiple accounts on any platform cleanly. — Comfort with or fast willingness to learn proxies, incognito browsing, and US phone number sourcing. Strong bonus: — Experience with ATS platforms like Lever, Greenhouse, iCIMS. — Experience on software demo or sales calls. — LinkedIn Recruiter or LinkedIn job slot experience. — Any background in lead generation, performance marketing, or recruitment operations. COMPENSATION — Base: $500 – $800 per month depending on experience — Performance bonus tied directly to applicant volume and results — Hours: Full-time, 10–12 hours per day in early phase — Timezone: Indian afternoon and night hours for US overlap — Growth path: Specialist ? Operations Manager as team grows TO APPLY — ANSWER ALL 7 QUESTIONS. SKIP ANY QUESTION = APPLICATION IGNORED. THIS INSTRUCTION IS ITSELF PART OF THE TEST. 1. Tell me specifically which job boards you have posted on, how many listings you managed at once, and what results you saw in terms of applicant volume. Be specific — platform names, numbers, timeframes. 2. How do you make sure a job listing actually gets seen and indexed properly — not just submitted? What do you know about this? 3. Tell me about something complex you taught yourself using only videos or brief instructions. How quickly did you get good at it and how do you know? 4. Have you ever managed multiple accounts on any platform simultaneously — keeping them clean and separate? Describe exactly how you did it. 5. Have you ever researched a company and joined a demo or sales call to set up a software account? Describe it honestly. 6. Describe a time something kept failing and you tried multiple approaches until it worked. What happened? 7. Are you available full-time, 10–12 hours per day, working Indian afternoon and night hours for US timezone overlap?

description: WE’RE HIRING! JOIN OUR TEAM! Position: QA Manager Company: Baton ( ---------- ) Location: 100% Remote (WFH) Work Hours: Mountain Standard Time Rate/Salary: $8-10 per hour About the Role Baton is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented QA Manager to oversee quality assurance, compliance, buyer performance, and traffic quality across our call marketplace. This role is responsible for monitoring call quality, publisher compliance, buyer performance, refund trends, and operational risks to ensure the marketplace maintains high standards of quality and accountability. The QA Manager will proactively identify issues, investigate root causes, and work cross-functionally with Publisher Management, Client Success, Operations, Sales, and Leadership to improve conversion outcomes, reduce preventable credits, and strengthen partner performance. This is a highly visible role that combines quality assurance, compliance oversight, reporting, operational analysis, and process improvement. Key Responsibilities Credit & Refund Oversight - Monitor credit and refund trends by buyer, campaign, publisher, sub-ID, and category. - Identify recurring fail reasons, unusual approval rates, and emerging patterns. - Investigate whether issues originate from traffic quality or buyer-side operational failures. - Flag buyers with excessive refund requests or abnormal credit behavior. - Develop recurring reports highlighting refund drivers and trends. - Recommend corrective actions including routing adjustments, bid changes, publisher feedback, buyer coaching, and traffic filtering improvements. Call Quality Assurance - Review call recordings, transcripts, and call outcomes on a daily and weekly basis. - Evaluate transfer quality, buyer call handling, and overall caller experience. - Review AI-assisted call interactions where applicable. - Identify fraud, coached callers, low-intent leads, wrong-service inquiries, compliance concerns, and other quality issues. - Maintain a library of common quality issues, examples, and training materials. Buyer Performance Monitoring - Track buyer answer rates, connection rates, call handling effectiveness, and responsiveness. - Identify buyers missing calls, creating poor caller experiences, or generating avoidable credits. - Analyze operational issues impacting conversion performance. - Surface trends by buyer, region, and campaign. - Escalate performance concerns to Sales, Client Success, Operations, and Leadership teams. - Support initiatives that improve buyer accountability and service levels. Compliance Management - Maintain publisher compliance records and documentation. - Ensure required certifications, disclosures, traffic source information, and supporting materials are current and complete. - Monitor renewal and recertification requirements. - Review landing pages, disclaimers, and traffic source declarations for compliance. - Investigate TCPA-related concerns and other compliance alerts. - Escalate high-risk publishers or traffic sources when necessary. - Maintain audit-ready compliance documentation. Alert Monitoring & Investigation - Monitor alerts related to fraud, TCPA risk, answer-rate issues, abnormal call behavior, and - refund spikes. - Conduct root cause investigations and document findings. - Recommend and track corrective actions. - Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve recurring issues. Reporting & Trend Analysis - Develop and maintain QA scorecards and performance dashboards. - Create recurring reports for leadership on: - Traffic quality - Buyer performance - Refund trends - Compliance risk - Operational performance - Translate data into actionable recommendations. - Measure the effectiveness of implemented solutions over time. SOP Ownership & Process Improvement - Create, document, and maintain standard operating procedures for: - Call reviews - Compliance reviews - Refund investigations - Escalation management - Quality assurance processes - Standardize QA definitions, audit criteria, and review methodologies. - Improve workflows between QA, Publisher Management, Sales, Client Success, and Operations. - Assist with training and coaching around recurring quality and compliance issues. Escalation Management - Serve as the primary point of contact for quality and compliance escalations. - Route issues to the appropriate teams and stakeholders. - Track investigations through resolution. - Identify systemic issues and implement long-term solutions. Additional Responsibilities - Audit call disposition accuracy and consistency. - Review category mapping and call routing logic. - Monitor buyer coverage failures and no-answer trends. - Support dispute resolution through call reviews and documentation. - Maintain training examples of approved versus non-approved traffic. - Partner with Data and Engineering teams to improve dashboards, alerts, and reporting. - Help establish thresholds for buyer warnings, pauses, and escalations. Qualifications Required - 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Compliance, Operations, Call Center Management, - Lead Generation, Performance Marketing, or a related field. - Strong analytical and investigative skills. - Experience reviewing call recordings, transcripts, and performance data. - Ability to identify trends and root causes across large datasets. - Strong reporting and dashboard experience. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. - Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail. - Experience creating SOPs, documentation, and process improvements. Preferred - Experience in pay-per-call, lead generation, affiliate marketing, or call marketplaces. - Familiarity with TCPA compliance and call tracking platforms. - Experience working with publisher networks, buyers, and performance marketing ecosystems. - Experience with AI-driven call handling or conversational AI platforms. - Experience using CRM, BI, and reporting tools. Success Metrics (KPIs) - Accurate and timely delivery of credit and refund trend reporting. - Percentage of active publishers reviewed monthly. - Percentage of high-risk buyers audited monthly. - Time to investigate and escalate quality concerns. - Reduction in preventable credits and refunds. - Reduction in buyer-side answer rate and connectivity issues. - Reduction in invalid, misrouted, or wrong-category calls. - Compliance documentation completion and audit readiness. - Alert investigation and resolution rates. - QA audit volume, quality, and turnaround time. What Success Looks Like The successful QA Manager will create visibility into marketplace quality, identify risks before they become costly problems, improve buyer and publisher accountability, strengthen compliance standards, and help Baton maximize revenue by reducing preventable credits and operational inefficiencies.

title: CEO Right-Hand / Property Operations VA — Assertive, Proactive, Full-Time
job_title: CEO Right-Hand / Property Operations VA — Assertive, Proactive, Full-Time
description: Go Home, LLC CEO Right-Hand / Property Operations VA Full-Time, Assertive, Proactive Operator Type of Work: Full Time Starting Rate: $3.00/hour Hours: 40 hours per week Schedule: 5 working days per week within a Monday through Saturday operating window. Sundays are always off. Time Zone: Meaningful overlap with Chicago business hours required. I run a fast-moving property management business in Chicago. I need a full-time right-hand operator to help with tenant follow-up, vendor coordination, scheduling, documentation, admin work, and executive support. This is not a passive “wait for instructions” VA role. Your job is simple: Protect my time. Keep the business moving. Close loops. We manage rental properties in Chicago, including tenant issues, maintenance, rent collection, vendor coordination, paperwork, scheduling, and day-to-day operational fires. This role is for someone who wants to become the CEO’s operational backbone, not someone looking for easy admin work. ------------------Compensation Notice------------------ This role starts at $3.00/hour. The starting rate is fixed and not negotiable during the interview process. Do not apply with the idea that you will interview, impress me, and then ask for a higher starting rate. However, good people should not feel stuck. Strong performers can earn more responsibility and better compensation over time. Performance reviews may happen after 30 days and 90 days based on reliability, communication, ownership, judgment, attendance, throughput, and ability to close loops. If $3.00/hour is not acceptable as the starting rate, do not apply. If you are only looking for temporary work while searching for something better, do not apply. ------------------What You Will Do------------------ You will help with: • Tenant follow-up and rent/payment coordination • Calling or messaging tenants, vendors, and contractors • Scheduling maintenance and following up until work is done • Tracking open issues until they are fully closed • Updating spreadsheets, Trello cards, Google Drive files, and internal systems • Managing invoices, reminders, admin records, and documentation • Reviewing training videos and SOPs independently • Preparing summaries, updates, and next-step recommendations • Helping with scheduling, logistics, calendar coordination, and executive-support tasks This is not a narrow job-description role where you say, “That’s not my task.” If it is legal, professional, ethical, and helps buy back the CEO’s time, you should be willing to help handle it. ------------------Who This Role Is For------------------ This role is for you if: • You are assertive, not timid • You are comfortable making outbound calls • You can speak directly to tenants, vendors, and contractors • You do not freeze when someone is upset • You can self-train using videos, SOPs, screenshots, and written instructions • You ask good questions • You communicate clearly when something is unclear • You can handle direct feedback • You want to become a high-trust, long-term operator ------------------Who Should Not Apply------------------ Do not apply if: • You are shy on the phone • You avoid confrontation • You need step-by-step instructions for every task • You only want easy admin work • You disappear when confused • You say “done” when a task is only partially done • You dislike direct feedback • You cannot work consistently during agreed hours • You already have too many other clients or jobs • You plan to ask for more than $3.00/hour before proving yourself If you d ---------- the role is not for you, I expect professional communication and a clean handoff. Disappearing without notice is not acceptable. ------------------AI Tools and Throughput------------------ AI tools, including ChatGPT, are allowed. I care about throughput, judgment, and completed work. AI should help you move faster, organize better, summarize clearly, document work, and produce cleaner output. AI should not be used to avoid thinking, avoid phone calls, avoid decisions, avoid accountability, or send generic answers. If AI makes your work faster and more accurate, good. If AI makes you passive, vague, dependent, or generic, this role is not for you. ------------------Required Skills------------------ You must be strong in: • Spoken English • Written English • Phone communication • Tenant/customer service • Direct follow-up • Google Sheets or Excel • Gmail • Google Drive • Trello or similar task-management tools • Calendar/scheduling • Documentation • Self-learning • Prioritization • Problem-solving Property management, collections, dispatch, call center, executive assistant, legal admin, or operations experience is a major plus. ------------------Work Schedule------------------ This is a full-time role. Expected schedule: • 40 hours per week • 5 working days per week • Workdays may fall between Monday and Saturday • Sundays are always off • Must have meaningful overlap with Chicago business hours ------------------Application Instructions------------------ To apply, use this subject line: RIGHT HAND OPERATOR - $3 FIXED RATE Do not send a generic cover letter. Generic applications will be ignored. Answer every question below. ---------- . Rate Confirmation------------------ This role starts at $3.00/hour. Do you understand and accept that this is the fixed starting rate? Answer clearly: Yes, I accept the $3.00/hour fixed starting rate. ---------- . Direct Communication Test------------------ A tenant is late on rent and says: “I’m not paying the late fee. I had a hard month, and it’s unfair. Remove it.” Write exactly what you would say back to the tenant. Keep it short. Do not be rude. Do not be weak. ---------- . Judgment Test------------------ It is Monday morning. Three things happen at the same time: A tenant says there is no heat. A contractor missed a scheduled repair. A tenant is late on rent and avoiding payment. What do you handle first, second, and third? Explain why. ---------- . CEO Time-Buyback Test------------------ I tell you: “I am traveling tomorrow. I have a meeting, a workout plan, a meal schedule, a car issue, and several business tasks open. I need you to make tomorrow easier for me.” What steps would you take to help? Be specific. ---------- . Phone Confidence------------------ Are you comfortable making outbound calls to tenants, contractors, vendors, and leads? Answer clearly: Yes or No. Then explain your experience. ---------- . AI Judgment Test------------------ How do you use AI or ChatGPT to get more work done? Give one example. Also explain one situation where you should not rely on AI and should use your own judgment instead. ---------- . Availability------------------ What hours can you work in Chicago time? Are you available full-time? Do you currently have other jobs or clients? If yes, explain your current workload. ---------- . Long-Term Fit------------------ Are you looking for a long-term role or a temporary role? If you were offered a higher-paying opportunity after a few weeks or months, how would you handle that professionally? ---------- . Voice Sample------------------ Record a short 60 to 90 second voice note answering this: “Why would you be a strong right-hand operator for a direct, fast-moving CEO?” Include the link in your application. Applications without a voice sample may be ignored. ------------------Final Note------------------ I am not looking for someone who only interviews well. I am looking for someone who can work, communicate, follow up, learn quickly, and become useful fast. If you are reliable, assertive, direct, organized, and serious about growing into a long-term operator role, apply. If you want an easy role, vague expectations, flexible excuses, or a higher starting rate, do not apply.

We prioritize a "strategy-first" approach to lending, focusing on clear, jargon-free guidance to help our clients make informed, long-term financial decisions. We specialize in providing tailored solutions for first-home buyer loans, refinancing, and investment property purchases. The Role We are seeking a highly skilled, part-time SEO Specialist to elevate the technical SEO maturity of our website ( ---------- ). Your objective is to build enduring organic visibility across traditional search engines while simultaneously optimizing our content for the rapidly evolving landscape of Generative AI search engines (often referred to as Generative Engine Optimization or GEO). You will work collaboratively with our team in an agile, iterative sprint model where we agree on tasks, you execute, and we review together. Key Responsibilities Traditional & Technical SEO: Implement robust strategies to ensure our website ranks highly for high-intent mortgage queries in the competitive Sydney market. AI Searchability (GEO): Structure online content so it is surfaced, cited, and recommended by AI-driven search engines and conversational LLMs. Structured Data Implementation: Implement and audit comprehensive schema markup (such as FAQs, Organization, and Service schemas) to give AI clear context, as LLMs rely heavily on structured data to accurately interpret content. Content Formatting for Extraction: Format our educational articles and guides using clear heading hierarchies, bulleted lists, and direct answers, which are highly preferred by AI models for extraction and citation. Crawler Management: Audit our robots.txt files and server configurations to ensure that both traditional and AI crawlers can successfully access and read our content without being inadvertently blocked. Recency & Maintenance: Implement a schedule to regularly review and update existing content, leveraging the strong recency bias that AI systems use to select current, trustworthy sources. About You Demonstrated, verifiable experience improving searchability, organic traffic, and lead generation for service-based or finance businesses. Deep understanding of modern SEO best practices and emerging GEO techniques required to capture AI search visibility. Technical proficiency with Google Search Console, Google Analytics (GA4), schema markup deployment, and website architecture. Reliable, proactive, honest, and comfortable working within a strictly scoped, part-time hour cap. How to Apply (Please Read Carefully) Attention to detail is paramount for this role. To ensure you have read this description in its entirety, please follow these exact application steps: Use the subject line: "SEO Application: AUTHORITY" (Applications without this exact subject line will be automatically filtered out). Include a link to your updated resume or onlinejobs.ph profile. Provide a brief summary or a link to a specific project case study where you successfully improved the organic search visibility of a business. Confirm your availability for 8–10 hours per week and state your expected hourly rate in USD.

title: Sales Manager
description: Sales Operations Manager / AI Sales Performance Manager About Cynergists Cynergists provides advanced AI Agents designed to help businesses automate workflows, increase productivity, and unlock scalable growth. We do not just fill seats. We deploy intelligent operations. We are building the future of AI-powered business growth through agentic CRM systems, AI Workforce Agents, sales automation, lead generation, and intelligent follow-up systems. Our mission is to help small and mid-sized businesses scale like giants without needing bloated internal teams. The Role We are looking for a highly organized, assertive, and tech-curious Sales Operations Manager to help lead and manage our growing sales team. This is not a traditional sales manager role where you are expected to personally close every deal. Your main responsibility is to make sure the sales team is executing every day, following the process, using the CRM correctly, improving from AI-generated feedback, and moving opportunities through the pipeline. You will work directly inside the Cynergists CRM and with our AI Sales Trainer to monitor sales activity, review call performance, track follow-ups, identify stuck deals, and help each sales representative improve. The right person is calm under pressure, strong with details, comfortable holding people accountable, and excited about using AI to improve sales performance. Our uploaded sales role template emphasizes diagnostic selling, pipeline management, AI sales training, CRM usage, and market feedback as core responsibilities for Cynergists sales positions . This manager role builds on that foundation but focuses on leading the team and making sure the sales system runs properly. Key Responsibilities Sales Team Accountability Manage daily sales activity across the team, including calls, texts, email s, booked appointments, follow-ups, and pipeline movement. Ensure every sales representative is following the required sales process, completing assigned outreach, updating the CRM, and staying on top of their opportunities. Run daily or weekly check-ins with sales reps to review activity, performance, challenges, and next steps. Hold reps accountable when activity drops, follow-ups are missed, or pipeline records are incomplete. CRM and Pipeline Management Monitor the Cynergists CRM to ensure leads, contacts, opportunities, notes, tasks, and deal stages are updated correctly. Identify stale opportunities, missing follow-ups, incomplete contact records, and deals with no next step. Make sure every active prospect has a clear next action assigned. Track the full pipeline from first conversation to booked appointment, proposal, close, or lost deal. AI Sales Coaching and Performance Review Use Cynergists’ AI Sales Trainer and call scoring tools to review sales rep performance. Monitor call scores, conversation quality, objection handling, buyer sentiment, follow-up quality, and close attempts. Help sales reps understand their AI-generated feedback and turn it into better sales behavior. Identify patterns across the team, including weak openers, poor discovery, missed closes, pricing objections, or lack of urgency. Sales Reporting Prepare weekly sales performance reports for leadership. Track key sales metrics, including: Calls made Conversations started Appointments booked Show rate Follow-up completion Pipeline created Deals closed Close rate Average call score Rep-by-rep performance trends Flag underperforming reps and recommend corrective action. Sales Process Improvement Help improve scripts, sales workflows, CRM automations, objection handling, and follow-up sequences. Listen to feedback from business owners and sales reps to identify gaps in our offers, sales materials, or AI Agent catalog. Relay market feedback to leadership and the development team so Cynergists can improve its products and sales process. Training and Onboarding Assist with onboarding new sales representatives. Teach reps how to use the CRM, follow the sales process, review AI feedback, and manage their pipeline. Help create simple SOPs, checklists, and training materials for the sales team. Run roleplays and objection-handling practice when needed. What We Are Looking For Strong Accountability You must be comfortable holding sales reps accountable. This role is not just admin support. You need to be able to say, “This was not completed,” “This follow-up was missed,” or “Your call score dropped and we need to fix it.” Sales or Appointment Setting Experience You do not need to be a world-class closer, but you should understand sales activity, follow-up, objections, CRM pipelines, and appointment setting. Experience managing or supporting outbound sales teams is a major plus. CRM Experience Experience with Go High Level, HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, Pipedrive, or another CRM is preferred. You must be comfortable learning software quickly and working inside dashboards every day. Tech-Savvy Mindset You do not need to be a developer, but you must be excited about AI, automation, and software. You should be comfortable using AI tools to review performance, summarize activity, identify problems, and improve sales execution. Organized and Detail-Oriented You must be able to manage multiple reps, tasks, follow-ups, reports, and deadlines without letting things fall through the cracks. Clear Communication Strong written and verbal English communication is required. You will communicate with sales reps, leadership, and occasionally other departments, so clarity matters. Calm Under Pressure Sales teams move fast. Leads get missed. Reps get frustrated. Deals stall. We need someone who stays calm, solves problems, and keeps the team moving. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing appointment setters, sales reps, or virtual sales teams Experience working remotely Experience with Go High Level Experience with AI tools or sales automation Experience reviewing call recordings or sales performance Experience creating SOPs or training materials Experience working with U.S.-based companies Strong spreadsheet and reporting skills Performance Expectations Success in this role will be measured by: Sales reps completing required daily activity CRM records staying clean and updated Follow-ups being completed on time Pipeline stages being accurate Improvement in rep call scores Increase in appointments booked Increase in close rate Reduction in missed leads and stalled deals Clear weekly reporting to leadership Why Join Cynergists? Work in the Future of AI Sales You will be helping build and manage an AI-powered sales organization, not an outdated manual sales team. Real Leadership Opportunity As Cynergists grows, this role can become a larger leadership position managing more reps, more processes, and more revenue operations. Remote Work This is a remote position. You can work from your own space while supporting a fast-growing U.S.-based AI company. AI-Powered Training and Support You will have access to our AI Sales Trainer, CRM tools, call scoring, and internal systems to help you manage the team effectively. Growth-Oriented Culture We are building fast. The right person will have room to grow with the company. Schedule Full-time preferred. Must be available during core U.S. business hours for sales team check-ins, reporting, and leadership communication. Compensation Competitive monthly compensation based on experience. Performance bonuses may be available based on team sales activity, booked appointments, closed revenue, and CRM compliance. To Apply Submit your resume and a short cover letter explaining: Why you would be a strong fit to manage a sales team Your experience with CRM systems or sales operations Your experience holding people accountable Why you are interested in AI-powered sales

job_title: Real Estate Acquisitions - Closer - Land - Remote - USD
description: ABOUT US Synergy Land Partners is a growing U.S.-based company that buys vacant land directly from owners across the United States. We're not a giant call center — we're a tight, modern team that values working smart over grinding hard, takes care of its people, and uses the best tools available to make everyone more productive in their role. We're building a company we intend to be a great long-term home. SLP already has a strong cold outreach team generating a steady, consistent flow of qualified seller leads every week, plus a large backlog of existing leads waiting for the right person. We don't have a shortage of opportunity. We have a need for the right closer to capitalize on it. WHAT YOU'LL DO Leads come to you already qualified by our outreach team. Your job is to build the relationship and bring the deal home: • Call pre-qualified seller leads and build genuine rapport and trust with U.S. landowners over the phone • Evaluate and comp properties using dedicated land software to understand what a parcel is worth and what purchase price meets the company objectives • Present offers and negotiate purchase agreements using a consultative, two (and often more) call close approach. You're a trusted guide helping sellers make a decision that meets their goals, not a pushy salesperson • Relentlessly follow up — many of our best deals take weeks or months of patient nurturing before they close. The closer who follows up wins the deal. • Manage your pipeline in Follow Up Boss with disciplined stages and follow-up cadences • Own your numbers — track your activity and conversions, and review your pipeline weekly WHO YOU ARE • Fluent, natural English — you can hold an easy, confident, rapport-building conversation with a U.S. landowner. This is non-negotiable. • A proven closer — you know how to handle rejection, work objections, build trust, and ask for the deal over the phone • Real estate or land experience is a strong plus, but we'll train the right person on land specifics. Sales skill, willingness to learn, and drive matter most. • Organized and CRM-disciplined — comfortable managing a pipeline (we use Follow Up Boss) without anyone chasing you • Self-motivated and competitive — you are driven and confident that your consistent hard work will bring results and financial upside for you and the company • Long-term minded — you want to grow with a company, not fill a six-month gap WHO THIS IS FOR • Closers who've crushed it in phone-based sales (real estate, insurance, solar, high-ticket) • People who want to own their income, not wait for someone to hand it to them • Self-starters who thrive without constant check-ins • People hungry for uncapped earning potential who want to grow WHO THIS IS NOT FOR • People looking for a "chill" remote job with guaranteed income and low expectations • People easily discouraged by rejection • People who can't self-manage their time or pipeline • People who need constant hand-holding COMPENSATION • Base Salary: $1,500/month USD — paid regardless of closings, so you have stability through the longer land sales cycles • Commission (uncapped): 1% of gross profit on the first $20,000 of gross profit per closed deal, and 2% of gross profit on everything above $20,000. The bigger the deal you negotiate, the more you earn per dollar. (Gross profit = our sale price minus our purchase price. A $20,000-profit deal pays $200; a $40,000-profit deal pays $600.) • Realistic On-Target Earnings: $2,000–$2,500+/month TOTAL, with real upside as you close more deals and negotiate larger spreads. This structure is designed to make a serious, capable closer very well rewarded. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this isn't the fit. If you are confident in your ability to close deals, the upside is real. HOW TO APPLY To apply, please send: 1. A short video recording (2-3 minutes) — introduce yourself and briefly describe your sales/closing experience. For the second half, pretend you're opening a call with a U.S. landowner who owns a vacant parcel and explain how you would approach the first conversation with the lead. Provide the link to your video recording with your application. Applications without a recording will not be considered. 2. Your resume / CV

title: Accounting Operations Lead | Elevated Hospitality Partners
job_title: Accounting Operations Lead | Elevated Hospitality Partners
description: ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS | ACCOUNTING OPERATIONS LEAD Philippines - Independent Contractor | Full-Time ABOUT ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS Elevated Hospitality Partners supports a growing portfolio of short-term rental property management brands across multiple U.S. markets, including Texas, New Mexico, and California, with over 1,000 total properties. Our companies manage vacation rental homes on behalf of homeowners, with a focus on excellent guest experiences, thoughtful homeowner communication, strong local operations, and disciplined financial management. As we continue to grow, we are building a centralized finance and accounting function that can support our operating companies with consistency, accuracy, and scalability. We are looking for an experienced Accounting Operations Lead based in the Philippines to help manage our end-to-end accounting workflows across all markets. This is not a basic bookkeeping role. We are looking for a high-ownership accounting professional who has existing experience in the U.S. short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting space and understands the complexity of homeowner statements, homeowner payouts, vendor payments, tax filing and remittance, property-level accounting, and month-end close across multiple markets. IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT - Prior experience supporting a U.S.-based short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality business is required. - Experience with Guesty is strongly preferred, but not required. Experience with similar property management systems or short-term rental accounting workflows will also be considered. - CPA certification is preferred. ROLE OVERVIEW As the Accounting Operations Lead, you will report to the Chief Financial Officer and be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations across our three short-term rental brands. You will lead a small team of external and internal bookkeeping and accounting resources. Initially, much of the work will involve managing external bookkeeping and accounting partners, ensuring their work is completed accurately and on time, and taking day-to-day accounting coordination off the CFO’s plate. Over time, this role may help build, train, and lead internal accounting tea ---------- mbers as we bring more accounting processes in-house. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple accounting workstreams at once. You should be able to create structure, identify gaps, follow up on open items, and ensure accounting processes are completed accurately and on time. WORKING HOURS This is a full-time role aligned to U.S. Central Time. Required schedule: 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time, Monday-Friday. Central Daylight Time to Philippines Time: * 9:00am-5:00pm CDT = 10:00pm-6:00am PHT * Because the Philippines does not observe daylight saving time, the Philippines time equivalent may shift when the U.S. changes between CDT and CST. * Candidates must be comfortable working overnight Philippines hours on a consistent basis. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS This is a full-time independent contractor role based in the Philippines. * Base pay: $1,700-$2,300 USD per month, based on experience. * Compensation at the higher end of the range will be reserved for candidates with direct U.S. short-term rental accounting experience, Guesty experience, homeowner statement and payout experience, CPA certification, and prior leadership of bookkeeping or accounting resources. * 13th month pay: Offered in December and prorated for partial years. * PTO: Accrues at 1 paid day per month, usable after 90 days, with no annual rollover. * Long-term opportunity: This is intended to be a long-term role with the opportunity to grow into a broader accounting leadership position as we continue building our internal finance and accounting team. YOU WILL OWN * Day-to-day accounting operations across Sierra Sol, Third Coast, and Redwood Coast. * Month-end close coordination across all operating brands. * Chart of accounts maintenance and accounting structure improvements. * Homeowner statement review and homeowner payout support. * Vendor payment workflows and accounts payable coordination. * Tax filing and remittance support. * End-to-end accounting flows across property management systems, accounting platforms, banking/payment tools, and reporting processes. * Coordination and accountability of external and internal bookkeeping resources. * Accounting SOPs, checklists, calendars, and process documentation. ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES ACCOUNTING OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT * Manage day-to-day accounting workflows across Sierra Sol, Third Coast, and Redwood Coast. * Coordinate accounting activities across multiple markets, brands, entities, and accounting resources. * Serve as the primary operational point of contact for external and internal bookkeeping resources. * Ensure accounting tasks are completed accurately, consistently, and on schedule. * Maintain clear accounting task lists, close calendars, open-item trackers, and follow-up routines. * Identify process gaps, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve accounting workflows. * Create structure and accountability across the full accounting process. MONTH-END CLOSE * Own and coordinate the month-end close process across all operating brands. * Maintain the monthly close calendar and ensure deadlines are met. * Review reconciliations, open items, supporting schedules, and accounting workpapers. * Coordinate with bookkeeping and accounting resources to resolve missing information or discrepancies. * Prepare summaries of close status, unresolved issues, and items requiring CFO review. * Support timely preparation of market-level and company-level financial reporting. * Help ensure each market’s financials are accurate, consistent, and ready for leadership review. CHART OF ACCOUNTS AND FINANCIAL STRUCTURE * Help maintain and improve the chart of accounts across multiple entities and operating brands. * Ensure transactions are coded consistently across markets. * Support department, market, homeowner, property, and entity-level reporting needs. * Help create scalable accounting structures that support business growth. * Document accounting policies, workflows, coding rules, and reporting standards. * Identify where account structure, classes, departments, properties, or other reporting dimensions need to be improved. HOMEOWNER STATEMENTS AND PAYOUTS * Support the preparation, review, and accuracy of homeowner statements. * Help ensure homeowner payouts are processed accurately and on time. * Review homeowner charges, owner proceeds, adjustments, deductions, reimbursements, and management fees. * Investigate and resolve homeowner accounting questions or discrepancies. * Ensure property-level revenue, expenses, fees, and reimbursements are properly reflected. * Help maintain clean and accurate homeowner accounting records. VENDOR PAYMENTS AND PAYABLES * Manage and improve the vendor payment process. * Ensure vendor bills are properly received, coded, approved, and scheduled for payment. * Coordinate with market teams to resolve missing invoices, approvals, W-9s, or supporting details. * Support payment tracking, vendor statement review, and payables reporting. * Help ensure strong controls around vendor payments and expense approvals. * Identify recurring vendor payment issues and recommend process improvements. TAX FILING AND REMITTANCE SUPPORT * Support lodging tax, sales tax, occupancy tax, and other required tax filing and remittance processes. * Track filing deadlines and payment due dates by market. * Coordinate with internal and external resources to ensure filings are prepared and submitted on time. * Reconcile tax liability accounts and investigate discrepancies. * Maintain supporting records for tax filings, payments, and related schedules. * Help ensure tax processes are documented, repeatable, and scalable across markets. END-TO-END ACCOUNTING FLOWS * Manage accounting workflows across systems such as property management software, accounting platforms, payment tools, bank accounts, and reporting tools. * Support the flow of reservation revenue, guest payments, owner payouts, management fees, vendor charges, taxes, reimbursements, and company revenue. * Help reconcile data between property management systems, banking/payment platforms, and accounting software. * Identify broken workflows, missing data, duplicate entries, reconciliation issues, and process gaps. * Create and maintain SOPs for key accounting processes. SYSTEMS AND TOOLS * Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software is required. * Experience with Guesty is strongly preferred. * Experience with short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting systems is highly valuable. * Experience with tools such as Topkey, Breezeway, AppFolio, Buildium, Hostaway, Streamline, Track, OwnerRez, or similar platforms is a plus. * Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills are required. TEAM AND RESOURCE MANAGEMENT * Lead a small team of external and internal bookkeeping and accounting resources. * Assign tasks, follow up on progress, and hold resources accountable to deadlines. * Review work quality and escalate issues when needed. * Help train future accounting tea ---------- mbers as the internal team grows. * Build SOPs, checklists, and process documentation to support future scalability. * Help create a high-quality internal accounting function over time. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE * 5+ years of accounting, bookkeeping, finance operations, or related experience. * Prior experience supporting a U.S.-based short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality business. * Experience with homeowner statements, homeowner payouts, property-level accounting, trust/escrow-style workflows, or similar accounting processes. * Experience with U.S. accounting practices and working with U.S.-based companies. * Strong QuickBooks Online experience or experience with similar accounting platforms. * Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills. * Experience managing month-end close tasks and reconciliations. * Experience coordinating with bookkeepers, accountants, operators, or business leaders. * Strong written and spoken English communication skills. * Ability to work 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time. STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE * CPA certification. * Guesty experience. * Experience with short-term rental or vacation rental homeowner statements. * Experience with homeowner payouts and homeowner accounting. * Experience with lodging tax, occupancy tax, sales tax, or similar tax remittance processes. * Experience with multi-entity businesses. * Experience supporting multiple markets, locations, or operating companies. * Experience building accounting SOPs and process documentation. * Experience leading or supervising bookkeepers or accounting assistants. WHAT WE LOOK FOR * Highly organized and detail-oriented. * Proactive and comfortable taking ownership. * Strong follow-up and accountability. * Able to manage multiple deadlines and workstreams. * Comfortable working with U.S.-based leadership teams. * Able to identify accounting issues and recommend solutions. * Process-minded and interested in building scalable systems. * Clear, professional, and responsive in communication. * Comfortable leading other accounting resources. * Excited to grow with a company over time. LOCATION This role is fully remote within the Philippines. Candidates must have reliable internet, a quiet professional work environment, and the ability to work overnight Philippines hours aligned to U.S. Central Time. HOW TO APPLY Please submit the following: * Resume/CV. * Brief written summary of your accounting experience. * Details of your experience with U.S. short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting. * Any experience you have with Guesty or similar property management systems. * Any experience you have with homeowner statements, homeowner payouts, trust/escrow-style accounting, lodging tax, or month-end close. * Your experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting systems. * Your experience managing bookkeepers, accounting assistants, or external accounting resources. * Your expected monthly compensation in USD. * Your availability to work 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time. * Speedtest.net result screenshot. REQUIRED APPLICATION QUESTIONS Please answer the following questions in your application: 1. Describe your experience with U.S. short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting. 2. Have you worked with Guesty? If yes, what accounting-related tasks did you handle inside or connected to Guesty? 3. Have you prepared or reviewed homeowner or owner statements? Please explain. 4. Have you supported homeowner payouts, lodging tax, sales tax, occupancy tax, or trust/escrow-style accounting? 5. What accounting software have you used? Please describe your QuickBooks Online experience. 6. Tell us about a time you managed bookkeepers, accounting assistants, or external accounting resources. 7. Describe your month-end close experience. 8. Are you a CPA? If yes, please include details. 9. What is your expected monthly compensation in USD? 10. Can you consistently work 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time? Applications that do not describe relevant short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting experience will not be considered. Suggested email subject line: Accounting Operations Lead - [Your Name]

title: Personal Research & Executive Support Assistant
description: ## Overview I'm a busy professional and father based in Portugal. I need a sharp, AI-powered research assistant who can take a brief and come back with organized, actionable options. This is not a virtual receptionist role. This is research, sourcing, coordination, and organization across personal life projects — property renovation, education planning, health, travel, and more. ## AI Is Central to This Role I use AI extensively and I expect you to as well — ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, or whatever makes you fastest. The best person for this role is someone who already uses AI tools daily and understands how to get great results from them. **What great looks like:** - You use AI to find leads faster, compare options, and draft clear summaries - You know which tool works best for which task - You verify everything AI gives you — every link works, every supplier is real, every price is current - Your output is AI-accelerated but human-verified. Speed AND accuracy The difference between good and great in this role is judgment. AI can find 50 results in seconds. Your job is to verify the best 5 and present them clearly. In your application, tell me which AI tools you use and how they fit into your workflow. I'm genuinely interested in how you work. ## What You'll Actually Do **Research & Sourcing (Primary — ~60% of time)** - Product sourcing: building materials, tiles, fixtures, equipment, furniture — find suppliers, compare pricing, compile options with photos and links - Service provider research: find specialists, coaches, practitioners across multiple domains. Compile profiles, availability, pricing, contact details - Education research: homeschooling resources, curricula, programs, activities for a young child - Travel logistics: flights, accommodation, itineraries, visa requirements - Health & wellness: research practitioners, equipment, suppliers (natural/holistic focus) - General: anything I need investigated, compared, or compiled **Organization & Coordination (~25% of time)** - Maintain organized research files and shared documents - Follow up with vendors/contacts on my behalf (English-language) - Schedule coordination (not calendar management — more like "find 3 available slots with this person") - Track project progress and outstanding items - Compile weekly summary of open tasks and findings **Ad-Hoc Support (~15% of time)** - Surprise tasks that don't fit a category - "Can you find out..." questions that need digging - Price monitoring on specific items - Booking confirmations, reservation management ## What I'm Looking For **Must have:** - Excellent English (written and spoken) - Daily AI user — you already use AI tools as part of your workflow, not experimenting with them - Strong research skills — you know how to dig deep, cross-reference, and verify - Self-directed. I give you a brief, you come back with results. You don't wait for step-by-step instructions - Organized. Your output is clean — tables, links, photos, pricing, contact details. Not a wall of text - Reliable. You hit deadlines. If something is going to be late, you tell me before it's due, not after - Available during European morning hours (CET/WEST — Portugal is GMT+0/+1). Core overlap needed: 08:00-12:00 Lisbon time - Comfortable working independently - Meetings will happen daily at the beginning to share context and get started. **Nice to have:** - Experience supporting someone in a personal (non-corporate) capacity - Familiarity with European suppliers and shipping - Interest in health, wellness, natural living, or property renovation (you'll be researching these constantly) - Basic Portuguese or Spanish (helpful for reading supplier websites, not required) **Personality fit:** - High agency. You see a problem, you solve it. You don't flag it and wait - Low drama. Professional, clear communication - Hungry. You take pride in delivering excellent work, not just completing tasks - Honest. If you can't find something, say so. Don't pad results to look productive ## Hours & Compensation - **Full-time: 40 hours/week** (Monday-Friday) - **Schedule:** work your own hours but core overlap 08:00-12:00 Lisbon time required - **Rate:** Competitive for experience level — please include your expected monthly rate - **Tools:** Google Workspace, AI tools, messaging app (Slack/Signal/whatsapp), task management tool (Notion) - **Payment:** Bi-weekly, via Wise or equivalent ## How to Apply **Step 1:** Send me a brief message covering: (please create a loom video addressing me by name) 1. Your relevant experience (keep it to 3-4 sentences) 2. Why this role appeals to you specifically 3. Which AI tools you use daily and how they fit into your research workflow (be specific) 4. Your expected monthly rate for full-time (40 hours/week) --- *I respond to every serious application. If you put in the effort on the test task, you'll hear back within 48 hours.*
