description: About Second Hour Second Hour is an independent Australian watch company founded in Melbourne by Peter and Akira Sargison. We design and manufacture strictly limited-edition mechanical watches using Swiss and Japanese movements, a proprietary hi-tech surface hardening treatment, and in-house design from concept to quality control. We are not a big brand. We are not a retailer. We are a small, founder-led company that makes watches the way they should be made — without compromise, without trend-chasing, and without volume targets. Every piece ships globally via DHL Express fro ---------- lbourne. Our price range is $525–$1,325 AUD. Our buyers are watch enthusiasts who research carefully, value craft, and respond to authentic content over polished marketing. They know what a good wrist roll looks like. They notice bad light. They can spot a cheap prop. This is a premium brand. Content quality directly reflects brand perception. We are looking for a creator who treats every shot as if it represents a $1,000+ purchase decision — because it does. The role We are hiring a freelance video and photography content creator based in the Philippines. We will ship Second Hour watches to you. You film and photograph them. We use the content across Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram feed, and Meta ads. Field Detail Position Freelance Content Creator — Watch Video & Photography Location Remote — Philippines (or South-East Asia) Arrangement Per-piece rate based on quality and experience Volume 10–20 pieces per month across video and photography Watch shipping Second Hour ships watches to you in the Philippines. You are responsible for safe handling and return shipping (we cover cost). Turnaround Agreed per batch — typically 5–7 business days per delivery Formats required Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram feed stills, Meta ad creatives Reports to Peter Sargison, Founder — via WhatsApp and email ? Content types required You will produce a mix of video and stills across the following formats. Each type has specific technical and creative requirements. Read these carefully before applying. VIDEO CONTENT Wrist rolls The cornerstone of watch content on Instagram and TikTok. The watch is on the wrist and the wrist rotates slowly toward camera, held in a specific light to maximise dial and case reflection. Requires smooth, controlled movement, correct angle, and a wrist that presents well on camera. • Format: vertical 9:16 for Reels/TikTok, square 1:1 for feed • Length: 5–15 seconds • Key requirement: the movement must be smooth and deliberate — no jerk or shake • Lighting: natural light preferred, softbox acceptable, ring light not acceptable Handling and detail sequences Close-up handling of the watch — picking it up, placing it down, clasp operation, crown manipulation, rotating the case to show the caseback. These are the shots that communicate finishing quality and scale. • Macro or near-macro focus on dial texture, indices, hands, and bezel • Caseback perlage (decorative finishing) must be captured on applicable models • Slow motion at 60fps+ preferred for handling sequences • Dark or neutral surface props only — no bright or branded backgrounds Unboxings The Second Hour unboxing experience is part of the product. The box, packaging, and presentation should be captured in a way that builds anticipation before the watch is revealed. • Clean surface, minimal props, camera locked off or on stabiliser • Hands should be well-presented — clean, no nail polish, no visible jewellery • Shoot the full sequence from sealed box to watch on wrist • Format: 9:16 vertical for Reels/TikTok, also provide a 1:1 edit of the reveal ---------- nt Pocket shots Watch is held loosely in the palm or between fingers — casual but considered. Used extensively as stop-scroll content on Instagram and for Meta ad thumbnails. • Watch face visible and in focus • Background: natural environments preferred (concrete, stone, wood, greenery) — not white studio • Both static image and short video versions required PHOTOGRAPHY CONTENT Hero product stills Clean, premium product photography for Instagram feed, website use, and Meta ad static creatives. These are the shots that appear alongside ad copy and need to communicate quality at a glance. • Flat lay on dark surface (slate, black fabric, brushed metal) • 3/4 angle and dial-on shot as standard deliverables for every watch • Correct focus on the dial — depth of field should render the dial sharp and the background soft • No filters. Colour grading in post is fine but must stay consistent with Second Hour’s dark, premium aesthetic Lifestyle and environmental stills Watch worn in natural environments. On the wrist during everyday activities — at a desk, with a coffee, hands on a steering wheel, outdoors. These are used for feed content and Meta prospecting ads. • Natural light strongly preferred • Environments should feel considered but not staged — authentic, not stock-photo • The watch must remain the focal point in every shot • Wrist size: ideally between 6.5–7.5 inches for correct proportions on our case sizes ? Reference content — the standard we are aiming for Before you apply, study these five Instagram accounts. They represent the content style, quality level, and attention to detail we are looking for. They represent the content style, quality level, and attention to detail we are looking for across different tiers and formats. We are not asking you to copy them — we are asking you to show that you understand what makes them work. Account Why we reference ---------- ---------- /fratellowatches — 258K followers. ‘Real people. Honest opinions.’ Study how they handle lighting on dark dials, the pace of their wrist shots, and the way finishing detail is communicated without staging or props. This is the aesthetic register Second Hour content should sit ---------- ---------- /whatknotman — 295K followers. Independent microbrand watch content creator. Directly comparable to Second Hour’s tier and price point. Note the macro photography technique, strap and bracelet handling shots, and understated ---------- ---------- /watchstudies — 400K followers. Watch Studies by Verne Ho. Exceptionally precise macro photography and dial study content. One of the strongest examples of how to make finishing detail the subject of a frame. Study the light placement on textured dials and the stillness of every ---------- ---------- /time.with.tyler — A smaller personal collector account recommended by Second Hour directly. Study the handling style, natural light usage, and the way the watch is positioned in everyday environments without forced ---------- ---------- /andre.watches — 5K followers, 703 posts. Andrea is a dedicated watch photographer whose body of work demonstrates consistent quality across macro stills, flat lays, and wrist shots. Strong reference for still photography technique specifically. Your application must include a link to your own Instagram, TikTok, or portfolio showing watch content you have produced. Applications without demonstrated watch content will not be considered regardless of general photography or videography skills. ? Technical requirements Requirement Minimum standard Camera iPhone 14 Pro or equivalent Android (or dedicated camera). Must be capable of macro/close-up focus and 4K or 60fps slow motion. Lighting Ability to control natural light or access to a softbox / diffused light setup. Ring lights produce unacceptable reflections on watch glass and are not suitable for this work. Stabilisation Tripod or stabiliser for locked-off shots. Smooth handheld technique for wrist rolls. Editing Basic colour grading and trimming in CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or equivalent. Deliverables must be exported at correct resolutions for each platform. Deliverable format Video: MP4, H.264, minimum 1080p. Stills: JPG minimum 3000px on the long edge, or RAW files on request. File delivery Google Drive or WeTransfer per batch. Organised by content type. ? Rates This is a per-piece arrangement. Rate per piece is negotiated based on your portfolio quality, demonstrated watch content experience, and the complexity of the deliverable. We do not pay a flat monthly retainer at this stage. Content type Rate range (USD) Notes Wrist roll (edited, Reels-ready): $15 – $35 Rate reflects quality and edit finish Handling / detail sequence: $12 – $28 Per edited sequence Unboxing video (full, edited): $25 – $50 Includes reveal ---------- nt edit Hero product still (3 angles): $10 – $25 Per watch, 3 deliverable images Lifestyle still set (5 images): $20 – $40 Per set, same watch and session Pocket shot (still + short video): $10 – $20 Per watch Meta ad creative (static): $8 – $18 Optimised crop + no-text version Higher rates are paid for higher quality work, consistently delivered on time. We start conservatively and increase rates as we build trust and see your work perform. Creators who produce content that generates strong engagement and ad performance are rewarded accordingly. Initial test batch: 3 pieces (your choice of type) at agreed entry rate. We review together before committing to ongoing volume.

Your job isn't to wait on me. Your job is to keep the ball moving. Design You take a brief and turn it into finished ad creative, Canva layouts, lead magnets, and marketing assets. You bring back polished work that's ready to launch. Not rough drafts. Not half-finished concepts. Finished work. Ad Support (Meta) You upload, QA, and publish creative in Meta Ads Manager. Share 3–5 design samples and tell me, in one line each, what the piece was for and what the goal was. 2. Walk me through your GoHighLevel experience. description: YouTube Story Editor & Content Support Specialist      5 to 10 hours per week to start The Expat Playbook ABOUT THE EXPAT PLAYBOOK The Expat Playbook is not a travel channel. It is a storytelling channel about reinvention, freedom, realization, and building a meaningful life after 50. Our audience includes retirees, veterans, solo travelers, expats, and people who feel stuck and are looking for a different path forward. While living abroad is often part of the story, our deeper focus is on transformation. We create content about: • Reinvention after 50 • Living abroad • Personal freedom • Retirement overseas • Veteran perspective • Starting over • Adventure and curiosity • Purpose and fulfillment • Building a life without regret Our videos combine voice-over storytelling, travel footage, daily life abroad, cinematic visuals, documentary-style editing, and thoughtful sound design. We are building a long-term brand and are looking for someone who wants to grow with us. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a story-driven editor who views editing as a craft. The ideal candidate is a lifelong student of editing and storytelling. They actively study great editors, take courses, analyze films and YouTube content, and continuously improve their skills. This is not simply a video editing job. It is a storytelling role. We are looking for someone who understands: • Narrative structure • Pacing • Emotional storytelling • Viewer psychology • Visual storytelling • Sound design • Documentary editing • YouTube audience retention Maturity, professionalism, curiosity, and strong communication skills are highly valued. If you love editing, love learning, and believe every cut should serve a purpose, we would love to hear from you. RESPONSIBILITIES Video Editing • Edit long-form YouTube videos • Edit YouTube Shorts • Create rough cuts and review versions • Organize footage and project files • Maintain a consistent channel style Storytelling • Match visuals to narration • Help shape emotional moments • Improve pacing and viewer engagement • Edit for clarity and comprehension • Support the overall story, not just the visuals Captions & Graphics • Create captions when needed • Add quote overlays • Add chapter titles and lower thirds • Create simple graphics that support the story Audio & Sound Design • Clean up voice-over audio • Balance narration, music, and ambient sounds • Add subtle sound design when appropriate • Enhance immersion without distracting from the story Content Support • Source stock footage when needed • Source royalty-free music • Assist with AI-generated visuals when appropriate • Help organize channel assets and project files REQUIRED SKILLS • Strong English comprehension • Experience with YouTube editing • Strong attention to detail • Ability to follow creative direction • Good communication • Reliable internet connection Software proficiency in one or more of the following: • Adobe Premiere Pro • DaVinci Resolve • Final Cut Pro • CapCut PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Documentary editing experience • Travel or lifestyle channel experience • Experience with sound design • Experience with color correction • Experience sourcing stock footage • Familiarity with AI tools and modern editing workflows • Interest in storytelling, psychology, filmmaking, or personal development Bonus Skills • Photoshop • Canva • AI image generation • AI video generation • Motion graphics • Thumbnail design • YouTube Studio • Storyboarding and content research OUR EDITING PHILOSOPHY Every edit serves the story. Story comes before effects. Meaning comes before trends. We are not trying to create flashy videos. We are trying to create videos that help viewers think, reflect, learn, and take action. WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR • TikTok-style editing • Meme editing • Gaming-style editing • Excessive transitions • Constant zoom effects • Random sound effects • MrBeast-style editing Our audience is mature and thoughtful. We value clarity, emotion, and storytelling. PAID TEST EDIT Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid test edit. The test may include: • Voice-over narration • Raw footage • Stock footage • AI-generated visuals • Basic editing instructions Applicants will be evaluated on: • Storytelling ability • Visual matching • Pacing • Sound design • Attention to detail • Communication COMPENSATION Please include: • Your hourly rate • Your per-video rate • Weekly availability • Time zone • Portfolio links APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS Please include: A brief introduction Your editing experience Three examples of your work Software you use Your hourly rate Your weekly availability Also answer the following question: What is the difference between editing a story and simply editing a video? To help us identify applicants who pay attention to detail, please include the phrase: "Story first." somewhere in your application. Applications that do not follow instructions may not be reviewed. LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY We are looking for a long-term creative partner who wants to grow with the channel and help build meaningful content that inspires people to rethink what's possible in the second half of life.

title: Accounts Receivable and Debt Collection
description: Accounts Receivable and Debt Collection Specialist (Remote) We're a tech company in the food industry, looking for a sharp, detail-focused Accounts receivable and Debt Collection Specialist to recover recent outstanding payments from our Australian customers. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take ownership, solve problems, and chase payment while keeping customer relationships strong. About the role: You'll be front and centre contacting customers to collect on recent outstanding invoices — this is current debt recovery, not long-term or aged debt chasing. Your focus is getting invoices paid quickly and cleanly, and making sure every payment can be allocated correctly. Our customers often have complex invoicing structures across different departments and geographical areas within Australia, and invoices sometimes need corrections before a customer can pay. You'll work closely with our Customer Care and Invoicing teams to get those corrections actioned so payment can be collected without delay. What you'll do: - Contact customers directly on email to collect on recent outstanding invoices - Identify where invoices need correcting and coordinate with Customer Care and the Invoicing team to get them fixed - Obtain remittance advice from every customer you're chasing, so payments can be allocated accurately - Keep clear, organised records of who's been contacted, what's outstanding, and what's been resolved - Maintain positive customer relationships throughout — chasing payment firmly but professionally You'll need: - Strong attention to detail — this is critical to the role - Excellent spoken English for adhoc customer meetings and calls - Excellent written English for clear, professional email s - Great communication and relationship skills — able to push for payment while keeping customers on good terms - Strong problem-solving ability and a sense of ownership - A self-starter who can take direction once and run with it independently Details: Part-time: 4 hours per day, 5 days per week (20 hours/week) Rate: AUD $10/hour Remote Reports to: Gina Lewis-Enright (Financial Director) Hours/timezone: tba Programs you will use: In-House Tech Platform MetaBase (reporting tool) Excel Slack Possible growth opportunity, depending on performance, to FT with Xero taking ownership of Bank reconciliations and Accounts Payable

title: Digital Content Director & Video Editor (Part-Time with Full-Time Scale Potential)
job_title: Digital Content Director & Video Editor (Part-Time with Full-Time Scale Potential)
description: *** PAYMENT SCHEDULE: This position is paid Bi-Monthly (twice per month) on a fixed, predictable corporate schedule. *** *** IMPORTANT NOTE: While this position is listed as Part-Time (20 hours/week) to start, we are explicitly looking for a professional with the desire and capability to scale to a Full-Time, 40-hour salaried position within 30-60 days based on performance and channel scaling. *** POSITION OVERVIEW: The VEXXIA Lifestyle Entity is seeking a high-agency, long-term Digital Content Director & Video Editor to manage our multi-channel video pipeline. You will be handed a massive 5-year vault of premium, raw international and domestic travel footage, alongside fresh weekly lifestyle and business product recordings. Your single core focus is to turn raw assets into a high-retention storytelling machine. NOTE: Because this role involves handling highly confidential personal footage, behind-the-scenes assets from major network TV productions, and proprietary business materials, a signed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is a mandatory condition of employment. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. The YouTube Long-Form Show: Produce ONE premium, high-retention long-form episode per week from raw, unorganized, and unnamed footage dumps. You must be comfortable scrubbing raw files to piece together a dynamic narrative. 2. The Social Media Splitting: Extract and edit a MINIMUM of three high-velocity vertical short-form clips per week from the master episode to syndicate across shorts feeds. 3. The Product Engine: Edit THREE short vertical product-showcase clips per week for our 3D printing e-commerce division (raw footage of finished items provided, no long-form editing required). 4. Full Digital Distribution & SEO: Manage our Metricool dashboard to schedule and cross-post all assets. You are entirely responsible for top-tier SEO (titles, detailed metadata, tags, deep descriptions), writing captions, designing cover stills, and creating THREE variations of high-click-through thumbnails per long-form video for split testing. REQUIRED CREATIVE EDITING STYLE: We execute "High-Retention Cinematic Editing." You must study channels like HopeScope, Ryan Trahan, and Hangtime to fit our aesthetic workflow. * The Pacing: Hyper-fast, changing visual scales, camera moves, or B-roll inserts every 3-5 seconds. However, you must leave tiny micro-pauses of breathing room for natural voice humor and dry delivery to shine. No robotic over-chopping. * The Graphics & Text Style (High-Attention Revenue Engine): On-screen text, callouts, and info-graphics must be highly dynamic, energetic, and fully animated (pops, slides, and motion-tracking) to maximize viewer retention. We want a polished, high-end production look that feels expensive and drives massive engagement. You have total creative freedom to use high-contrast text, stylized graphics, neon highlights, and attention-grabbing pop-ups to punch up the comedic timing, highlight the story pacing, and keep eyes locked on the screen. * The Hook & Frame: Every long-form video must open with 5-10 seconds of intense, high-stakes manufactured opening drama (the curiosity hook) before hitting a clean, gamified chapter structure using leaderboard tallies and progressive step counters on screen. APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS: If you are an independent problem solver who thrives under low micromanagement and can turn unorganized folders into master-level media properties, we want you. To apply, please reply with a link to your current video portfolio or sample sheet. IMPORTANT: To prove your attention to detail, you must start your response to this listing with the words "SIDE QUEST" in all capital letters. Applications without this keyword will be automatically deleted. We look forward to building this empire with you!

description: We are chasing our dream in Magdalena, Laguna — purchasing agricultural land in Brgy. San Isidro and developing it into a home and farm. Before we finalize the purchase, we need someone on the ground to gather key information and quotes from local offices and contractors. What we need help with: • Visit the Municipal Engineering Office of Magdalena to request referrals for local gravel road contractors • Visit or call the barangay captain of Brgy. San Isidro to ask about water grid availability and connection cost • Contact Meralco San Pablo regarding electricity connection requirements and cost estimate for our property • Contact Laguna Water to confirm if the area falls within their service coverage • Collect rough quotes from contractors for: gravel road construction (approximately 427m, 4.5m wide), deep well drilling, electricity connection, and water connection to the local grid network • Compile all findings into a clear written summary report Please note: we are in the process of commissioning a geodetic survey of the property, which will provide the accurate terrain and distance data contractors typically need for final quotes. For now, rough estimates based on the location and general scope are what we are after. Quotes can be refined later once survey data is available. What we are looking for: • Based in or near Magdalena, San Pablo, or Sta. Cruz, Laguna • Fluent in Tagalog and English • Someone who follows through — you do what you say you will do • A fast mover when it comes to gathering information — you know how to get answers quickly • Creative with problem solving — if one door is closed you find another way • Able to deliver a clear written summary of findings, not just a verbal update • Experience in construction, land, or property coordination is a plus but not required Compensation: Base rate is PHP 4,000 per day with a PHP 500 daily transport allowance, capped at 5 billable days. We reward speed and thoroughness. A completion bonus is available based on how quickly all tasks are delivered with quality written reports: PHP 15,000 for completion within 3 days, PHP 10,000 within 5 days, and PHP 5,000 within 7 days. No bonus applies after 7 days. We also offer PHP 3,000 per category for every quote we end up using from the four areas: electricity connection, gravel road construction, deep well system, and water grid connection — up to PHP 12,000 additional if we use your quotes across all categories. All quotes must include the contractor’s name and contact number for independent verification. Total compensation ranges from PHP 22,500 (5 days, no bonuses) to PHP 40,500 (completed in 3 days with quotes used across all categories). To apply, send a short introduction about yourself, where you are based, and any relevant experience.

description: URGENT HIRING **HIRING: Experienced Cold Caller (Remote)** We are looking for an experienced Cold Caller to join our team. **Requirements:** * Proven experience in cold calling and appointment setting * Clear and professional English communication skills * Confident speaking with business owners * Ability to handle objections and build rapport * Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment * Experience with CRM systems is a plus **To Apply, Please Send:** 1. Your resume 2. A voice recording using the script below 3. A brief summary of your cold-calling experience **Recording Script:** Agent: Hi, is this Jane? Prospect: Yes. Agent: Hi Jane, this is Mary with Bizwai. I'll be very brief—we work with small business owners, including contractors, to clean up bookkeeping, improve cash flow visibility, and show which jobs are actually making money. If they hesitate: "No problem. It is not a sales presentation. It is more of a quick diagnostic. If everything looks good, we'll tell you that. If we see something that can save time, clean up the books, or improve cash flow visibility, we'll show you." Calendar Close: "Great. I'll send a calendar invite. What email should I use?"

title: Social Media & Content Assistant
description: Important notes Pay can be negotiated up if work is amazing after 3 months You should have a computer for basic editing You should have graphic design skills . Canva and photoshop ——— Undefined Marketing is looking for a highly organized, creative, and dependable Social Media & Content Assistant to support our agency and the clients we serve. We primarily work with construction companies, contractors, home-improvement businesses, and other local service brands. This role combines social media management, content research, copywriting, graphic design, project coordination, and content-library organization. You will help take content from the idea stage through publishing, while keeping our team, files, and client deliverables organized. Core Responsibilities 1. Social Media Posting & Platform Management • Schedule and publish content on Instagram, Facebook , TikTok, YouTube, Google Business Profile, and Yelp. • Write platform-specific captions, titles, descriptions, hashtags, keywords, and calls to action. • Upload YouTube videos and Shorts, including thumbnails, titles, descriptions, playlists, and tags when needed. • Confirm that every post is published correctly, on time, and formatted properly for each platform. • Maintain an organized content calendar for all clients, including upcoming, scheduled, and published posts. • Keep a complete record of every posted video, graphic, carousel, and photo. 2. Weekly Content Research, Ideas & Scripts • Research content ideas within each client’s niche and identify topics we can film every week. • Find high-performing videos, trends, hooks, formats, and competitor examples that can be adapted for our clients. • Create organized weekly lists of content ideas for upcoming shoots. • Develop short-form scripts, opening hooks, talking points, interview questions, calls to action, and shooting-style recommendations. • Organize reference videos and explain why each example is useful or likely to perform well. • Research construction, real estate, home improvement, and other local-service industries as assigned. 3. Video Library & Raw Footage Organization • Review our existing video library and identify footage that can be repurposed into new content. • Go through raw footage, rename files, organize folders, and prepare clips for our video editors. • Identify footage that can become Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, long-form videos, before-and-after posts, educational videos, or promotional content. • Match raw footage with content ideas, scripts, hooks, and editing references. • Create clear editing notes and content briefs so editors understand the goal, structure, and key message of each video. • Maintain an accurate production tracker showing each video’s status from idea to publication. Suggested production stages: Idea | Scripted | Filmed | Sent to Editor | In Revision | Approved | Scheduled | Published | Repurposed | Archived 4. Canva Graphic Design & Digital Resources • Create professional, on-brand graphics for our agency and clients using Canva. • Design Instagram carousels, educational posts, promotional graphics, testimonials, before-and-after posts, service graphics, holiday posts, Stories, and YouTube thumbnails. • Create useful downloadable resources, including e-books, guides, checklists, lead magnets, and client educational materials. • Follow each client’s brand guidelines, including logos, fonts, colors, photo style, and overall visual direction. • Proofread all graphics and verify names, phone numbers, websites, pricing, and calls to action before approval. 5. Performance Tracking & Reporting • Track the performance of posted videos, graphics, carousels, and photos. • Monitor views, reach, engagement, watch time, retention, shares, saves, comments, follower growth, and leads when available. • Identify the best-performing hooks, topics, formats, lengths, and editing styles. • Maintain a library of winning posts that can be recreated, updated, or repurposed. • Prepare organized weekly or monthly performance summaries and recommend what the team should create next. 6. Photo Editing Coordination & Team Support • Coordinate with our photo editor to make sure client photos are assigned, edited, reviewed, and completed on time. • Provide editors with the correct footage, photos, logos, brand assets, instructions, references, and deadlines. • Review completed work for missing files, incorrect logos, spelling mistakes, formatting issues, or missed instructions. • Follow up on revisions and help keep projects moving without unnecessary delays. • Maintain organized client folders, content calendars, asset libraries, and project-management boards. Qualifications • Experience managing social media for a business, agency, creator, or client account. • Strong written English, grammar, proofreading, and communication skills. • Experience using Canva and creating polished, professional graphics. • Working knowledge of Instagram, Facebook , TikTok, YouTube, Yelp, and Google Business Profile. • Strong online research skills and the ability to recognize strong hooks, trends, and content formats. • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through. • Experience using Google Drive, Dropbox, Google Sheets, or similar tools. • Ability to manage multiple clients, assignments, and deadlines at the same time. • Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and ask useful questions when needed. • Reliable computer, stable internet connection, and consistent availability. Preferred or Bonus Skills • Experience with construction, real estate, home improvement, local service businesses, or marketing agencies. • Basic video editing experience using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar software. • YouTube SEO, thumbnail, title, and keyword experience. • Copywriting experience for social media, websites, ads, or lead-generation campaigns. • Experience creating e-books, guides, checklists, or downloadable lead magnets. • Experience with Photoshop or other photo-design tools. • Experience with ClickUp, Monday, Asana, Trello, or another project-management platform. • Understanding of paid advertising, lead generation, analytics, or social media reporting. What We Are Looking For Creative You actively look for new ideas, trends, angles, and ways to improve content. Organized You can manage large content libraries, trackers, deadlines, and multiple clients. Proactive You notice what needs to be done and move projects forward without constant supervision. Detail-Oriented You catch spelling errors, missing assets, incorrect information, and publishing mistakes. Dependable You communicate consistently, meet deadlines, and follow through on assignments. Growth-Minded You are interested in learning new industries and growing into a larger content-management role. How to Apply Please include the following with your application: • A brief introduction about yourself. • Your résumé. • Examples of social media accounts you have managed. • Three to five Canva graphics or carousels you have created. • Any e-books, guides, checklists, or lead magnets you have designed. • One example of a short-form video script with a strong opening hook. • Your expected monthly salary or hourly rate. • Your weekly availability and preferred working hours. • A list of the software, social platforms, and project-management tools you have experience using.

title: Collections Caller Agent -
description: About the Role North Funding is a Canadian direct lender providing merchant cash advances to small and medium sized businesses across North America. We are looking for a professional and composed collections caller to join our team on a part time remote basis. Your role is simple. Every business day you receive a list of merchants with missed or delinquent payments. You call them, you listen, you work with them to find a resolution, and you log everything accurately. You are not aggressive. You are not threatening. You are a professional who helps business owners get back on track while protecting the interests of the company. What You Will Do Receive the daily delinquent account report from our operations coordinator every morning by 9am Eastern time. The report includes merchant name, phone number, deal ID, outstanding balance, number of missed payments, and last contact date. Call every merchant on the daily list. Attempt each merchant at least twice per day at different times if there is no answer on the first attempt. Leave a brief professional voi cemail on the first attempt if the merchant does not pick up. Work through the conversation calmly and professionally. Identify the reason for the missed payment, offer appropriate resolution options within your defined authority, and agree on a clear next step with the merchant before ending the call. Log every call attempt in our CRM immediately after each call. Record whether the merchant was reached, what was discussed, and what outcome was agreed. Accurate and complete logging is a non negotiable requirement of this role. Send our operations coordinator a daily end of day summary covering every account you called, the outcome of each call, and any payment arrangements that were agreed. Flag the operations coordinator immediately if a merchant is unresponsive after multiple attempts, aggressive or threatening, or refusing all cooperation. You never escalate directly to management. All escalations go through the operations coordinator. Payment Arrangement Authority You have full authority to offer the following arrangements without any approval needed. Reduced payment arrangement. You may offer to accept 50% of the merchant's daily payment amount for up to 10 consecutive business days while they stabilize their cash flow. Log the agreed start date and end date in the CRM immediately. Short payment holiday. You may offer to pause payments entirely for up to 5 consecutive business days. This option can only be offered once per merchant per 6 month period. Log the agreed pause dates in the CRM immediately. Any arrangement outside these parameters must be escalated to the operations coordinator. You never promise anything you do not have authority to deliver. What You Never Do Discuss legal action, court proceedings, or collections agencies with any merchant under any circumstances. Make promises about credit reporting or removing negative marks from any record. Accept payment by any method other than the merchant's existing pre-authorized debit arrangement or a direct wire to our company bank account. Contact merchants outside of Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm Eastern time. Argue, raise your voice, or engage with an aggressive merchant beyond one calm attempt to de-escalate. What We Are Looking For Based in the Philippines with reliable internet connection and availability during Eastern business hours. Strong conversational English with clear pronunciation. Calm, professional, and composed when dealing with stressed or difficult business owners. Previous experience in collections, debt recovery, customer service, or financial services outbound calling is required. Comfortable learning and using a CRM system for call logging. Detail oriented with strong written communication for daily reporting. Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

I'm looking for someone to work permanently with me which means this a long term job and not a job that lasts for a few months or a couple of years. title: Grant Writer (for music/entertainment nonprofit organization)
description: Our organization is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit working upstream of the youth mental health crisis by turning fandom into a real protective force for young people. We meet teens and young adults in the music, artists, and fan communities they already love... and we deliver evidence-based mental health support in the cultural language they actually speak. After nine years of building community trust inside fandoms (500K+ fans reached, partnerships with major artists and labels, a published book on the work), we're in a critical growth ---------- nt: launching our first fan-native toolkit, deepening retail and label partnerships (including Hot Topic, where we've already secured funding interest), and building toward becoming the infrastructure layer for upstream youth mental health. We're looking for a grant writer to help fuel the next phase. The Role This is a performance-based grant writer role: you earn a percentage of every grant you successfully source and secure for our nonprofit organization. Note that there is no base salary by default but for the right candidate with the right experience, we can discuss a small monthly retainer in addition to the success fee as we're open to the structure that works for both sides. You'll work closely with the Founder/CEO and our Project Manager to identify opportunities, write compelling proposals, and steward funder relationships. The work spans foundation grants, corporate philanthropy, corporate and brand sponsorships, and government funding sources at the intersection of youth mental health, music, arts, and community wellbeing. What You'd Do > Research and identify grant (or sponsorships) opportunities aligned with our organization's mission (foundation, corporate, and government) > Write and submit grant proposals, letters of inquiry, and concept papers > Maintain a grant pipeline tracker (what's been applied for, what's pending, what's been funded) > Manage application deadlines and submission requirements > Coordinate with the Founder on funder cultivation strategy > Draft funder stewardship communications (thank-yous, progress reports, renewal asks) > Build a growing library of grant materials (boilerplate, impact data, narratives) that can be reused across applications What Success Looks Like (baseline) In the first 90 days, we anticipate that you have: > Identified at least 15-20 well-matched grant opportunities for Superbands > Submitted at least 5-8 strong applications > Built a working grant pipeline tracker that becomes a permanent operational asset > Begun a steady cadence of submissions and follow-ups > Ideally secure at least 1-2 grants Over the first year, you'll have secured meaningful funding that fuels our organization's next phase, and you'll have earned compensation tied directly to that success. Note that should you be successful in the initial 90 day period, part time and/or full time employment opportunities may be provided so you can grow with our organization long term and continue to ensure our funding pipeline is blossoming. Our small team of 4 has been with us long term already and has grown with us... are YOU next? Compensation Structure > Success fee: 10-12% of grants you successfully source and secure, paid when funds land in our org's account. > Eligible grants: Any grant that you (a) identify and source, OR (b) write the bulk of the proposal for, where our org had not previously been in active conversation with the funder. > Not eligible: Grants from the 2 funders already in our active pipeline at the time you start (list of funders provided at start), or grants secured primarily through the Founder's existing relationships. Payment: Within 7-14 days of grant funds arriving in our NPO's account(s). Paid via Wise, PayPal, or direct deposit. ** Note - Retainer option (for the right candidate): If you have substantial grant-writing experience and prefer a hybrid structure, we're open to discussing a small monthly retainer in addition to a reduced success fee. Tell us what would work for you in your application. Who You Are > Experienced grant writer with a track record of secured funding (at any organizational stage — early-career to senior, we're open) > Comfortable working independently and managing your own pipeline > Strong writer who can translate complex mission work into compelling, fundable narratives > Detail-oriented on application requirements, deadlines, and stewardship Genuinely care about youth mental health, music/fandom culture, or upstream prevention *(this work won't feel right if you don't get the mission) > Understand that performance-based compensation means real upside and real risk, and you're going into it with eyes open Bonus if you have: > Existing relationships in mental health, arts, music, or youth-focused funding > Experience writing for both foundation and corporate philanthropy > Familiarity with the protective factor / public health framing of mental health work > Experience in pitching corporate sponsorships or partnerships What This Isn't - To save us both time: > This is not a salaried staff role (unless we evolve into one together over time as the organization grows) > This is not a fit if you need predictable monthly income from this role alone > This is not a fit if you're looking to "make it big" off one or two grants. Currently our NPO is a real, growing nonprofit with a long runway of opportunity, but it's not a quick win > We're not interested in writers who don't understand or believe in the mission. We'd rather work with the right person at lower volume than the wrong person at higher How to Apply Send the following in response to job posting for our team's review: > Your CV/resume or a summary of grant-writing experience, including notable secured funding (org names + amounts are great, but ranges are fine if confidentiality matters) > A short note (1-2 paragraphs) on why this role and this mission resonates with you > One writing sample, ideally a grant narrative, letter of inquiry, or proposal section you wrote We read every application sent in this format and respond to everyone within two weeks.
